steps: Cook the fettuccine in boiling salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Fry the chicken in the oil for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic, cream and crumbled stock cube and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, broccoli and parmesan.
Season and serve.

name: Lemon and ricotta pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water, saving a mugful of the water.
Mix the ricotta, lemon zest, juice, parmesan and oil in a large bowl.
Add the drained pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss until creamy.
Season and top with basil.

name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, half the garam masala, cumin, paprika and a pinch of salt. Marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Grill the chicken on a hot grill tray for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, remaining garam masala and chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth if you like, then stir in the cream and the grilled chicken.
Simmer for 5 minutes, season to taste and scatter over the coriander.

name: Chicken korma
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and korma paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the chicken and brown it lightly on all sides.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, then simmer gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the ground almonds, sugar and yoghurt and warm through without boiling.
Season, scatter over the coriander and serve with rice.

name: Chicken jalfrezi
steps: Heat half the oil in a wok or large pan and fry the chicken until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil and fry the onions and peppers over a high heat for 5 minutes so they keep some bite.
Add the garlic, ginger and all the ground spices and stir for 1 minute.
Tip in the chopped tomatoes and green chillies and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan and cook for 10 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir through the garam masala and season to taste.

name: Chicken madras
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and chilli powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato puree, then add the chicken and brown it for 3 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and stock, bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Finish with the lemon juice, season and sprinkle over the coriander.

name: Chicken bhuna
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until well browned, as this gives the bhuna its depth.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and fry for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and tomato puree and cook down for 8 minutes into a thick paste.
Add the chicken with 100ml water and cook, covered, for 15 minutes.
Uncover and cook until the sauce clings to the chicken. Stir in the garam masala and coriander.

name: Chicken dopiaza
ingredients: 3 onions, 2 finely chopped and 1 cut into wedges
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and fry the chopped onions for 10 minutes until golden brown.
Add the cumin seeds, garlic and ginger, then the ground spices, and fry for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and tomatoes with 100ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a separate pan fry the onion wedges in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until just soft.
Stir the wedges and garam masala into the curry and finish with the coriander.

name: Chicken balti
steps: Heat the oil in a karahi or large frying pan and fry the onions for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and balti paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and pepper and stir over a high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato puree and 100ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the garam masala and coriander and serve straight from the pan with naan.

name: Lamb rogan josh
steps: Brown the lamb in batches in the oil and set aside.
Fry the onions in the same pan for 10 minutes until golden, then add the garlic and ginger.
Add the paprika, cumin, coriander, chilli and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute.
Return the lamb, add the tomatoes and 200ml water, then cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt a spoonful at a time and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Finish with the garam masala.

name: Lamb bhuna
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until deeply golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and brown for 5 minutes, then stir in the tomatoes, puree and 150ml water.
Cover and simmer on a low heat for 1 hour 20 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Uncover and reduce until the sauce is thick and clinging. Add the garam masala and coriander.

name: Lamb keema
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and fry for 1 minute.
Add the lamb mince and break it up, cooking for 8 minutes until browned.
Add the tomatoes and 100ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce is thick.
Stir in the garam masala, season, and top with the coriander.

name: Keema peas
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato puree and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the peas and cook for 5 minutes. Finish with the garam masala and coriander.

name: Chicken dhansak
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown lightly.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils break down.
Stir in the lemon juice and sugar to give the classic sweet and sour edge.
Season and scatter with coriander.

name: Chicken pathia
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, add the chicken and brown for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and 100ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chutney and lemon juice, simmer for 3 minutes, then top with coriander.

name: Chicken vindaloo
steps: Mix the chicken with the vinegar, garlic, ginger, cumin, chilli, paprika and turmeric. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the marinated chicken and tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and 100ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
Season and serve with rice to tame the heat.

name: Butter chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt, 1 teaspoon garam masala, paprika and a pinch of salt for at least 20 minutes.
Melt half the butter and fry the chicken for 8 minutes until lightly charred. Set aside.
Melt the remaining butter and fry the onion for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger.
Add the tomatoes, puree and remaining garam masala and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend until smooth.
Return the chicken, add the cream and sugar and simmer for 8 minutes.

name: Chicken curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 3 minutes, then pour in the tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the yoghurt, season and finish with the coriander.

name: Beef curry
steps: Brown the beef in batches in half the oil and set aside.
Fry the onions in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, return the beef and add the tomatoes and stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the potatoes and cook for 25 minutes until tender. Stir in the garam masala and season.

name: Prawn curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Add the lime juice, season and top with coriander.

name: Fish curry
ingredients: 600g haddock fillets, skinned and cut into chunks
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander and chilli and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and tomatoes and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Slide in the fish and poach for 6 to 8 minutes without stirring too much so it stays in chunks.
Add the lime juice, season and top with coriander.

name: Saag aloo
ingredients: 600g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes until just tender. Drain.
Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and coriander and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and fry for 5 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the spinach in handfuls until wilted, then season and stir in the garam masala.

name: Saag paneer
steps: Fry the paneer cubes in half the oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Wilt the spinach in a pan or microwave, then blitz to a rough puree.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Stir in the spinach puree and 100ml water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer, cream and garam masala, season and heat through.

name: Paneer tikka
steps: Mix the yoghurt, spices, tomato puree, garlic, oil and lemon juice with a pinch of salt.
Add the paneer, pepper and onion and coat well. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers, alternating paneer and vegetables.
Grill under a hot grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges.
Serve with lemon wedges and raita.

name: Chana masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and 100ml water and simmer for 15 minutes, lightly crushing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in the garam masala, season and top with coriander.

name: Tarka dhal
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and water for 20 to 25 minutes, skimming off any foam, until soft and creamy.
Season with salt and keep warm.
For the tarka, heat the oil and fry the cumin and mustard seeds until they pop.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and chilli powder for 1 minute.
Pour the tarka over the dhal and finish with lemon juice.

name: Red lentil dhal
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and garam masala and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and soft.
Season well and stir through the coriander.

name: Aloo gobi
ingredients: 500g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and coriander and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower, tomatoes and 100ml water.
Cover and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the garam masala and season to taste.

name: Bombay potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes until nearly tender. Drain.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard and cumin seeds until they pop.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, turmeric and chilli powder.
Add the potatoes and tomatoes and fry for 10 minutes until the potatoes are coated and lightly crisp.
Season and finish with the coriander.

name: Vegetable curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and carrots and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and courgette and cook for 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peas, cook for 3 minutes and season well.

name: Sweet potato and chickpea curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes and coconut milk and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season to taste.

name: Chicken biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt, curry powder, garlic, ginger and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden. Remove half for topping.
Add the chicken and its marinade to the pan and cook for 15 minutes.
Boil the rice with the cardamom and cinnamon for 5 minutes, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken, scatter over the saffron and reserved onions, cover tightly and cook on a low heat for 20 minutes.
Top with coriander and serve with raita.

name: Lamb biryani
steps: Marinate the lamb in the yoghurt, curry powder, garlic, ginger and salt for at least 1 hour.
Fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden. Remove half for topping.
Add the lamb with its marinade and 150ml water. Cover and simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Boil the rice with the cardamom and cinnamon for 5 minutes, then drain.
Spread the rice over the lamb, scatter over the saffron, cover tightly and cook on a very low heat for 20 minutes.
Top with the reserved onions and mint.

name: Vegetable biryani
steps: Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes, then drain.
Fry the onions in the oil for 12 minutes until golden. Set a quarter aside for the top.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder, then the carrots and cauliflower. Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt, peas and 100ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the rice over the vegetables, cover tightly and steam on a low heat for 15 minutes.
Top with the reserved onions and coriander.

name: Pilau rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Heat the oil and fry the onion for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the cinnamon, cardamom, cumin seeds and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and water with a good pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

name: Naan bread
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Add the yoghurt, water and oil and mix to a soft dough. Knead for 5 minutes.
Cover and leave to rise for 30 minutes.
Divide into 4, roll each into a teardrop shape and heat a heavy frying pan until very hot.
Cook each naan for 2 minutes per side until puffed and charred in spots. Brush with melted butter.

name: Chapati
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add the oil and enough warm water to make a soft dough.
Knead for 5 minutes, then rest under a damp cloth for 20 minutes.
Divide into 8 balls and roll each very thin on a floured surface.
Cook in a dry hot frying pan for 1 minute per side, pressing gently so they puff.
Brush lightly with oil and keep warm in a cloth.

name: Onion bhajis
steps: Mix the onions with the gram flour, spices, salt and coriander.
Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of water, a little at a time, until the batter just binds the onions.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C.
Fry spoonfuls of the mixture in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve hot with mango chutney.

name: Vegetable samosas
steps: Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes until tender, then drain and lightly crush.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the spices and stir for 1 minute.
Mix in the potatoes and peas, season well and let the filling cool.
Cut the filo sheets into strips, brush with butter, and fold a spoonful of filling into triangles.
Place on a baking tray, brush with butter and bake at 200C for 18 to 20 minutes until golden.

name: Vegetable pakora
steps: Mix the gram flour, spices and salt, then whisk in about 150ml cold water to make a thick batter.
Stir in the onion, potato and spinach.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C.
Drop in spoonfuls of the mixture and fry for 4 to 5 minutes until golden.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve with chutney.

name: Poppadoms with dips
steps: Cook the poppadoms in the microwave for 40 to 60 seconds each, or fry them in hot oil for a few seconds.
Mix the yoghurt, mint and cucumber with a pinch of salt for a cooling dip.
Mix the onion, tomatoes and lime juice for a fresh onion salad.
Serve the poppadoms with the mango chutney and both dips.

name: Raita
steps: Squeeze the excess water out of the grated cucumber.
Mix the cucumber into the yoghurt with the mint, cumin and lemon juice.
Season with salt and chill until ready to serve.

name: Mango chutney chicken
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Stir in the chutney and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Season and top with coriander.

name: Tandoori chicken
steps: Slash the chicken thighs a few times with a knife.
Mix the yoghurt, tandoori paste, paprika, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, oil and a pinch of salt.
Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Roast on a tray at 220C for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with sliced onion and lemon wedges.

name: Chicken tikka skewers
steps: Mix the yoghurt, tikka paste, garlic, lemon juice, oil and a pinch of salt.
Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken, pepper and onion onto skewers.
Grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with warm naan and raita.

name: Lamb kofta curry
steps: Mix the mince with the cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, fresh coriander and salt. Roll into 16 small balls.
Brown the koftas in half the oil, then set aside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the koftas and cook gently for 15 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick.

name: Sri Lankan chicken curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, cinnamon, curry leaves and chilli and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 25 minutes until tender.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

name: Thai red curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir to coat for 2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and green beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and top with coriander.

name: Thai massaman curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, then add the potatoes and onion.
Simmer for 30 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is tender.
Stir in the peanut butter, fish sauce and tamarind and simmer for 3 minutes.
Top with the roasted peanuts.

name: Thai yellow curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock and add the potatoes.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and top with coriander.

name: Thai jungle curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, and add the aubergine and carrot.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then add the green beans and cook for 5 minutes. The curry has no coconut milk, so it is thin and fiery.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice and stir in the basil.

name: Malaysian chicken curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and 100ml water, then add the potatoes.
Simmer for 30 minutes until the chicken and potatoes are tender.
Add the soy sauce, sugar and lime juice, and adjust the seasoning.

name: Laksa
steps: Fry the laksa paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stock and coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes, then add the prawns for 3 minutes.
Cook the noodles according to the packet, then drain and divide between bowls.
Season the broth with the fish sauce and lime juice and ladle over the noodles.
Top with beansprouts, spring onions and coriander.

name: Beef rendang
steps: Blend the onions, garlic, ginger and chillies into a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the coriander, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the beef and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind, sugar and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 2 hours 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick, dark and almost dry.

name: Chicken katsu curry
steps: Fry the onion and carrots in 1 tablespoon of oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of flour, then gradually add the stock, soy sauce and honey.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then blitz until smooth.
Coat the chicken in the 50g flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in the remaining oil for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Slice the chicken and serve with rice and the sauce.

name: Vegetable katsu curry
steps: Fry the onion and carrots in 1 tablespoon of oil for 8 minutes, then stir in the curry powder and 1 tablespoon of flour.
Gradually add the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Blitz until smooth.
Parboil the sweet potato for 4 minutes and drain well.
Coat the sweet potato and aubergine in the 50g flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in the remaining oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with rice and the sauce.

name: Japanese curry
ingredients: 3 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Brown the beef in the oil and set aside.
Fry the onions in the same pan for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, curry powder and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the stock, soy sauce and tomato puree.
Return the beef and add the carrots, potatoes and apple. Simmer for 40 minutes until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick.
Serve over short-grain rice.

name: Katsu curry sauce
steps: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock gradually, with the soy sauce and honey.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Blitz until smooth and season to taste.

name: Caribbean lamb curry
steps: Rub the lamb with half the curry powder, the garlic, ginger and salt. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onions for 6 minutes, add the remaining curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the thyme, whole scotch bonnet, coconut milk and 200ml water. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook for 25 minutes until tender. Remove the chilli and top with spring onions.

name: Jamaican jerk chicken
steps: Mix the jerk seasoning, spring onions, garlic, soy sauce, lime juice, oil, sugar and chilli.
Slash the chicken and rub in the marinade. Marinate for at least 2 hours, ideally overnight.
Roast on a tray at 200C for 35 to 40 minutes, basting once, until charred and cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with rice and peas.

name: Jamaican curry chicken
steps: Rub the chicken with 2 tablespoons of curry powder, the garlic and salt. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the remaining curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the thyme, scotch bonnet, potatoes and stock and simmer for 30 minutes until tender and thick.
Remove the chilli and sprinkle with spring onions.

name: Coconut dhal
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, coconut milk and stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then add the lime juice and season well.

name: Chicken and chickpea curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach to wilt, season and top with coriander.

name: Slow cooker chicken curry
steps: Put the onions, garlic, ginger, curry powder, tomatoes, tomato puree and stock in the slow cooker and stir.
Add the chicken and potatoes and season well.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender.
Stir in the peas and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt just before serving.

name: Curry in a hurry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes over a high heat.
Add the garlic and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and fry for 3 minutes until sealed.
Pour in the tomatoes, water and chutney and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Season and top with coriander.

name: Egg curry
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in cold water, then peel.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger and ground spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and 100ml water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Halve the eggs and add to the sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala and top with coriander.

name: Chicken korma with almonds
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft but not coloured.
Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin and garam masala and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes, then pour in the stock and ground almonds.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the cream, season and warm through. Scatter over the toasted almonds.

name: Lamb saag
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onions for 10 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb, add the tomatoes and 150ml water. Cover and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Wilt the spinach separately, blitz to a rough puree and stir it into the curry.
Cook for 10 minutes, then add the garam masala and season.

name: Keralan fish curry
ingredients: 600g haddock fillets, skinned and cut into chunks
steps: Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves until they pop.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and chilli powder.
Pour in the coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and poach gently for 6 to 8 minutes without stirring too much.
Season and serve with rice.

name: Goan prawn curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, turmeric and chilli powder and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and tamarind, add the green chillies and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until pink.
Season and top with coriander.

name: Lamb korma
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onion for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and korma paste for 2 minutes.
Return the lamb, add the coconut milk and stock and simmer, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Stir in the ground almonds and yoghurt and simmer for 10 minutes without boiling.
Season and top with coriander.

name: Chicken pasanda
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft and pale golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes, then add the ground almonds and 150ml water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the yoghurt, cream and sugar, warm through without boiling, and season.

name: Lamb madras
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onions for 10 minutes until deep golden, then add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and chilli for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, return the lamb and add the tomatoes and 150ml water.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes, then uncover and cook for 10 minutes until thick.
Finish with the lemon juice and season.

name: Lamb karahi
steps: Heat the oil in a karahi or wide pan and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and lamb. Brown for 6 minutes.
Add the ground coriander, chilli powder and tomatoes with 100ml water.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes until the lamb is tender and the oil separates.
Add the green chillies and garam masala and top with fresh coriander.

name: Chicken karahi
steps: Heat the oil in a karahi or wide pan, fry the cumin seeds, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and brown over a high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, ground coriander, chilli powder and salt. Cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Uncover and cook until the sauce is thick and the oil separates.
Add the green chillies and garam masala and top with coriander.

name: Prawn bhuna
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and tomato puree and cook down for 8 minutes into a thick paste.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until pink.
Season and top with coriander.

name: King prawn masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until pink.
Finish with the lemon juice and season.

name: Dal makhani
ingredients: 250g black lentils or green lentils, rinsed
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 35 to 40 minutes until soft. Drain, keeping a cupful of the water.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, garam masala and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the lentils, kidney beans and a splash of the cooking water. Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing some of the lentils.
Stir in the butter and cream, season and serve.

name: Mushroom masala
steps: Fry the mushrooms in half the oil over a high heat until golden. Set aside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and ground spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala, season and top with coriander.

name: Bhindi masala
steps: Heat half the oil and fry the okra for 8 minutes until lightly browned. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil and cumin seeds, then the onion and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, then return the okra.
Cook for 5 minutes, season, and finish with the lemon juice.

name: Baingan bharta
steps: Prick the aubergines and roast at 220C for 40 minutes until collapsed. Cool slightly.
Scoop out the flesh and chop roughly, discarding the skin.
Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, then add the onion and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and coriander, then the tomatoes, and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the aubergine, cook for 5 minutes, season and top with coriander.

name: Paneer butter masala
steps: Melt half the butter and fry the paneer until golden. Set aside.
Melt the remaining butter and fry the onion for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the tomatoes and tomato puree and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend until smooth.
Return to the pan, add the cream, sugar and paneer, and heat gently for 5 minutes.
Season to taste.

name: Matar paneer
steps: Fry the paneer in half the oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and ground spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the peas and paneer and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala and season.

name: Rajma
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans and 150ml water and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Stir in the garam masala and season.

name: Jeera rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds and bay leaf for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and water with a pinch of salt and bring to the boil.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

name: Lemon rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and spread out to cool slightly.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves until they pop.
Add the turmeric, green chillies and peanuts and stir for 30 seconds.
Toss the rice through the spices, then add the lemon juice and season.

name: Coconut rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Heat the oil in a pan, add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, water and salt and bring to the boil.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve with lime wedges.

name: Garlic and coriander naan
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the yoghurt and water and knead for 5 minutes.
Cover and leave to rise for 30 minutes.
Mix the garlic, butter and coriander together.
Divide the dough into 4 and roll into teardrops. Cook in a very hot dry frying pan for 2 minutes per side until puffed and charred.
Brush with the garlic butter and serve warm.

name: Peshwari naan
ingredients: 1 tbsp caster sugar, for the filling
steps: Mix the flour, yeast and 1 teaspoon of sugar with a pinch of salt, then add the yoghurt and water. Knead for 5 minutes and rise for 30 minutes.
Mix the almonds, coconut, sultanas and the tablespoon of sugar with a splash of water into a paste.
Divide the dough into 4, flatten each, add the filling, and fold the edges over to seal. Roll out gently.
Cook in a hot dry frying pan for 2 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Brush with melted butter.

name: Paratha
steps: Mix the flour and salt, add the oil and enough water to make a soft dough. Knead for 5 minutes and rest for 20 minutes.
Divide into 6 balls and roll each out thinly.
Brush with melted butter, fold into a half and half again to make a triangle, then roll out.
Cook in a hot dry frying pan for 2 minutes per side, brushing with butter, until golden and flaky.

name: Chicken pakora
steps: Toss the chicken with the garlic, lemon juice and salt and leave for 15 minutes.
Mix the gram flour and spices with about 150ml water to make a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C.
Dip the chicken in the batter and fry in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve with lemon wedges and raita.

name: Tandoori lamb chops
steps: Mix the yoghurt, tandoori paste, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, cumin, oil and a pinch of salt.
Coat the chops and marinate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Grill or roast at 220C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked to your liking.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Seekh kebabs
steps: Squeeze the juice out of the grated onion.
Mix the onion with the mince, garlic, ginger, spices, coriander and a good pinch of salt. Knead for 2 minutes.
Shape into long sausages around skewers.
Brush with oil and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with raita and onion rings.

name: Tandoori salmon
steps: Mix the yoghurt, tandoori paste, garlic, lemon juice and oil.
Coat the salmon and marinate for 20 minutes.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Top with coriander and serve with rice and raita.

name: Chicken saag
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then add the cream.
Season and simmer for 3 minutes.

name: Pork vindaloo
steps: Mix the pork with the vinegar, garlic, ginger, cumin, chilli, paprika, turmeric and salt. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the pork with its marinade and the tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the water, cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes until the pork is very tender.
Uncover and cook for 10 minutes to thicken. Season and serve with rice.

name: Vegetable korma
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and korma paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and carrots and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and courgette and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peas and ground almonds, cook for 3 minutes and season.

name: Panang curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, peanut butter, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the green beans and pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the basil and serve with rice.

name: Tom kha gai
steps: Bring the stock, coconut milk, curry paste and ginger to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes.
Season with the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar, tasting as you go.
Ladle into bowls and top with coriander.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, tamarind and sugar for the sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Push the chicken aside, add the eggs and scramble briefly.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes, then add the beansprouts and half the spring onions.
Serve topped with peanuts, the remaining spring onions and lime wedges.

name: Chicken satay
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce, for the sauce
steps: Mix the chicken with the 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, oil, turmeric and garlic. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Heat the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, sugar, lime juice and chilli in a pan, stirring until smooth.
Serve the skewers with the warm peanut sauce.

name: Nasi goreng
steps: Fry the chicken in half the oil for 6 minutes until cooked. Set aside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the rice, soy sauce and tomato puree and stir-fry over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Return the chicken and heat through.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan and serve on top with the spring onions.

name: Chip shop curry sauce and chips
steps: Toss the chips with 2 tablespoons of oil and roast at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, curry powder and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add the stock, chutney, sugar and soy sauce and simmer for 15 minutes until thick and glossy.
Blitz for a smooth sauce, if you like, and pour over the chips.

name: Mulligatawny soup
steps: Fry the onion and carrots in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, apple and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the chicken and lemon juice and warm through.
Season and serve with a spoon of yoghurt.

name: Singapore noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 4 minutes, then drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil for 5 minutes, add the prawns for 2 minutes. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil, then the eggs, and scramble briefly.
Add the pepper, curry powder and noodles and toss for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken and prawns, add the soy sauce, beansprouts and spring onions and toss for 2 minutes.

name: Chicken chettinad
steps: Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves until they pop.
Add the onions and cook for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin and black pepper and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Paneer jalfrezi
steps: Fry the paneer in half the oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Fry the onions and peppers in the remaining oil over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the paneer and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes.

name: Kachumber salad
steps: Mix the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, chillies and coriander in a bowl.
Add the lemon juice, cumin and salt and toss.
Leave for 5 minutes before serving with curry.

name: Mango lassi
steps: Put the mango pulp, yoghurt, milk, sugar and ice into a blender.
Add the seeds from the cardamom pods.
Blend until smooth and frothy, then pour into glasses.

name: Aloo tikki
ingredients: 600g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, drain well and mash.
Cook the peas for 3 minutes, drain and crush lightly.
Mix the potatoes, peas, spices, chilli, coriander, flour and salt.
Shape into 8 patties.
Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden, and serve with chutney.

name: Sweet and sour chicken
ingredients: 1 x 227g tin pineapple chunks in juice, drained (keep juice)
steps: Toss the chicken in the egg, then coat in the cornflour.
Shallow fry the chicken in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through, then drain on kitchen paper.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and 4 tbsp pineapple juice in a bowl.
Stir-fry the peppers and onion in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and pineapple and simmer for 3 minutes until glossy.
Add the chicken, toss to coat and serve with rice.

name: Sweet and sour pork
ingredients: 1 x 227g tin pineapple chunks in juice, drained (keep juice)
steps: Dip the pork in the egg, then coat in the cornflour.
Fry the pork in hot oil for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Whisk the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and 4 tbsp pineapple juice together.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Add the sauce and pineapple and bubble for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toss the pork through the sauce and serve with rice.

name: Chicken chow mein
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked.
Add the carrot, pepper and garlic and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the beansprouts and half the spring onions and cook for 1 minute.
Tip in the noodles, soy sauce and oyster sauce and toss over a high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve topped with the remaining spring onions.

name: Beef chow mein
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Heat 1 tbsp rapeseed oil in a wok until smoking and sear the beef for 1 to 2 minutes, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion, pepper and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the beansprouts and cook for 1 minute.
Return the beef with the noodles, soy sauce and oyster sauce and toss for 2 minutes until hot.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice to the pack instructions, drain and spread on a tray to cool and dry.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and scramble the beaten eggs until just set, then remove.
Heat the remaining oil and stir-fry the spring onions and peas for 1 minute.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry over a high heat for 3 minutes.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss well. Season to taste.

name: Special fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, drain and leave to cool and dry on a tray.
Scramble the beaten eggs in 1 tbsp oil in a hot wok, then remove.
Heat the remaining oil and fry the garlic, ham and peas for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Add the prawns, egg, spring onions, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss for 2 minutes.

name: Crispy chilli beef
ingredients: 500g beef rump steak, cut into thin strips
steps: Toss the beef in the egg white, then coat well in the cornflour.
Deep or shallow fry the beef in batches in hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp. Drain on kitchen paper.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and garlic in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chilli sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar and honey with 3 tbsp water and bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the beef, toss quickly and serve straight away with rice.

name: Kung pao chicken
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornflour and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the chillies for 30 seconds, then add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the pepper, garlic, ginger and most of the spring onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water and pour into the wok.
Bubble for 2 minutes, stir in the peanuts and serve with rice, topped with the rest of the spring onions.

name: Chicken in black bean sauce
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the pepper, onion, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in the black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar and stock.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and serve with rice.

name: Beef in black bean sauce
steps: Toss the beef in the cornflour.
Heat half the oil in a wok until smoking and sear the beef for 1 to 2 minutes, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the pepper, onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar and stock and bubble for 2 minutes.
Return the beef, toss through the sauce and serve with rice.

name: Lemon chicken
steps: Dip the chicken in the egg and coat in the cornflour.
Shallow fry in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper.
Dissolve the stock cube in 200ml boiling water and add the lemon juice, zest, sugar and soy sauce to a pan.
Mix the 1 tbsp cornflour with a splash of cold water, stir into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Pour the sauce over the chicken, scatter with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Salt and pepper chicken
steps: Mix the salt, pepper and five spice together.
Toss the chicken in the egg white, then the cornflour.
Fry in hot oil in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp and golden. Drain on kitchen paper.
Stir-fry the chilli, pepper, spring onions and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and sprinkle over the seasoning, toss well and serve.

name: Salt and pepper chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the chips in 2 tbsp oil and roast on a tray for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the salt, pepper and five spice.
Heat the remaining oil in a wok and stir-fry the chilli, pepper, garlic and spring onions for 2 minutes.
Tip in the hot chips, sprinkle over the seasoning and toss well.
Serve straight away.

name: Sesame chicken
steps: Dip the chicken in the egg, then the cornflour, and fry in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden. Drain.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ketchup and garlic in a small pan.
Stir the 1 tsp cornflour with 1 tbsp water, add to the pan and simmer for 2 minutes until sticky.
Toss the chicken in the sauce.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Cashew chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the pepper, onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 3 minutes.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 100ml water, pour in and bubble for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cashews and spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Char siu pork
ingredients: 800g pork shoulder, cut into long strips
steps: Mix the hoisin, 2 tbsp honey, soy sauces, vinegar, five spice, garlic and ginger.
Coat the pork in the marinade and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat the oven to 200C and place the pork on a rack over a tray lined with foil.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, basting with leftover marinade halfway.
Brush with the remaining honey and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until charred and sticky. Rest, then slice.

name: Crispy duck pancakes
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub the duck legs with the salt and five spice.
Place on a rack over a tray and roast for 2 hours until the meat is tender.
Raise the oven to 220C and roast for 15 to 20 minutes until the skin is crisp.
Warm the pancakes in a steamer or in the microwave according to the pack.
Shred the duck with two forks and serve with the pancakes, hoisin, cucumber and spring onions.

name: Prawn toast
steps: Blitz the prawns, egg white, soy sauce, cornflour, spring onions and ginger to a rough paste.
Trim the crusts off the bread and spread the paste thickly on each slice.
Press the paste side into the sesame seeds.
Shallow fry paste side down in 1cm hot oil for 2 minutes, then flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Drain on kitchen paper and cut each slice into triangles.

name: Spring rolls
steps: Stir-fry the carrot, cabbage, garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beansprouts, spring onions and soy sauce and cook for 1 minute. Cool completely.
Place a spoonful of filling on each wrapper, fold in the sides and roll up tightly, sealing with beaten egg.
Fry in hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Prawn crackers with sweet chilli dip
steps: Heat 2cm of oil in a deep pan until a cracker puffs up in seconds.
Fry the prawn crackers in small batches for 5 to 10 seconds until puffed and pale. Drain on kitchen paper.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli and spring onion into a dip.
Serve the crackers alongside the dip.

name: Chicken and sweetcorn soup
steps: Simmer the chicken breasts in the stock for 15 minutes until cooked, then remove and shred.
Add half the sweetcorn, the ginger and soy sauce to the stock and blitz until almost smooth.
Return to the pan with the remaining corn and the chicken.
Mix the cornflour with 4 tbsp cold water and stir in until the soup thickens.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg, stirring, then add the sesame oil. Season and top with spring onions.

name: Hot and sour soup
ingredients: 150g pork loin, cut into thin strips
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer and add the pork and mushrooms. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, vinegar, soy sauce and white pepper.
Mix the cornflour with 4 tbsp cold water and stir in until the soup thickens.
Pour in the egg in a thin stream, stirring gently to make ribbons.
Finish with the sesame oil and spring onions and taste for balance.

name: Wonton soup
steps: Mix the pork, prawns, 1 tbsp soy sauce, ginger, spring onions and sesame oil.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each wrapper, wet the edges and fold into parcels.
Bring the stock to a simmer with the remaining soy sauce.
Add the wontons and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they float and the filling is cooked.
Add the pak choi for the last 2 minutes and serve in deep bowls.

name: Chicken and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the broccoli, garlic and ginger with a splash of water and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and stock and pour in.
Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until glossy and serve with rice.

name: Beef and broccoli
steps: Toss the beef in the cornflour.
Sear the beef in 1 tbsp very hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, broccoli, garlic and ginger with a splash of water and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and stock and pour in. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Return the beef and toss until coated. Serve with rice.

name: Pork and pak choi stir-fry
steps: Toss the pork in the cornflour.
Stir-fry the pork in 1 tbsp hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic, ginger and chilli and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the pak choi and a splash of water and cook for 2 minutes.
Return the pork with the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

name: Prawn stir-fry
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and stir-fry the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes until pink, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the pepper, mangetout and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the prawns with the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil and toss for 1 minute.
Scatter with spring onions and serve with noodles or rice.

name: Tofu stir-fry
steps: Pat the tofu dry and toss in the cornflour.
Fry in 2 tbsp hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden on all sides, then remove.
Stir-fry the pepper, broccoli and mangetout in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and 3 tbsp water, return the tofu and toss gently. Serve with rice.

name: Vegetable stir-fry
steps: Heat the oil in a wok until very hot.
Stir-fry the onion, carrot and broccoli for 4 minutes.
Add the pepper, mangetout, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beansprouts, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss for 1 minute.
Serve with noodles or rice.

name: Teriyaki chicken
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, mirin, vinegar, garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken for 5 minutes each side until golden.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes, turning the chicken, until sticky.
Mix the cornflour with a splash of water and stir in to thicken the glaze.
Slice the chicken and serve with rice, sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Teriyaki salmon
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, mirin, vinegar, garlic and ginger and marinate the salmon for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes.
Turn and cook for 2 minutes more.
Pour in the remaining marinade and bubble for 1 to 2 minutes until sticky.
Serve with rice, scattered with sesame seeds and spring onion.

name: Chicken yakitori
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, cut into chunks
1 bunch spring onions, cut into 3cm lengths
steps: Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, vinegar, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes. Stir in the cornflour mixed with a splash of water to thicken.
Thread the chicken and spring onion alternately onto the skewers.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze often, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with any remaining glaze.

name: Chicken ramen
steps: Simmer the stock with the soy sauce, miso, garlic and ginger. Add the chicken and poach for 15 minutes, then remove and slice.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Add the mushrooms and pak choi to the broth for 3 minutes.
Cook the noodles to the pack instructions and drain.
Divide the noodles between bowls, ladle over the broth and top with chicken, egg and spring onions.

name: Miso soup
steps: Soak the wakame in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Heat the stock until just simmering.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of hot stock in a bowl until smooth, then stir back into the pan. Do not boil.
Add the tofu, wakame and soy sauce and warm through for 2 minutes.
Serve topped with spring onions.

name: Miso salmon
steps: Mix the miso, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Coat the salmon in the glaze and marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C and bake on a lined tray for 10 to 12 minutes until glazed and just cooked.
Steam or stir-fry the pak choi for 3 minutes.
Serve the salmon with pak choi, rice and spring onion.

name: Gyoza
steps: Mix the pork, cabbage, spring onions, garlic, ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Place a spoonful in each wrapper, wet the edge, then fold and pleat to seal.
Heat the oil in a lidded frying pan and fry the gyoza flat side down for 2 minutes until golden.
Add 100ml water, cover and steam for 4 to 5 minutes until the water has gone.
Mix the vinegar with the remaining soy sauce for dipping.

name: Chicken katsu sandwiches
steps: Flatten the chicken slightly. Coat in the flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in 1cm hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Drain.
Butter the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer the cabbage and chicken on 2 slices and drizzle with tonkatsu sauce.
Top with the remaining bread, press down and cut in half.

name: Sushi rice bowls
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook in 300ml water for 12 minutes and rest covered for 10.
Warm the vinegar and sugar until dissolved and fold through the rice. Leave to cool a little.
Toss the salmon with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with salmon, avocado and cucumber.
Finish with sesame seeds, nori and pickled ginger.

name: Poke bowls
steps: Cook the rice to the pack instructions and leave to cool slightly.
Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and honey.
Toss the salmon with half the dressing and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the edamame for 3 minutes in boiling water and drain.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the salmon, avocado, edamame, carrot and cucumber on top and spoon over the rest of the dressing. Top with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice and keep warm.
Marinate the beef in 2 tbsp soy sauce, half the sesame oil, the sugar and garlic for 15 minutes.
Stir-fry the carrot, courgette, spinach and beansprouts separately for 1 to 2 minutes each, seasoning with a splash of soy and sesame oil.
Fry the beef in a hot pan for 3 minutes.
Fry the eggs, then arrange the rice, vegetables, beef and eggs in bowls and serve with gochujang.

name: Korean fried chicken
steps: Mix the cornflour, plain flour and salt and toss the chicken through to coat.
Fry in oil at 170C in batches for 10 minutes until cooked, then drain.
Raise the heat to 190C and fry again for 3 to 4 minutes until very crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, vinegar and garlic for 3 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and scatter with sesame seeds.

name: Bulgogi beef
ingredients: 500g beef rump steak, very thinly sliced
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, pear, garlic and ginger.
Add the beef and onion and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan until very hot.
Cook the beef in two batches for 2 to 3 minutes until caramelised.
Top with spring onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice.

name: Kimchi fried rice
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the kimchi and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cold rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot and slightly crisp.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan until the whites are set.
Stir the sesame oil and half the spring onions into the rice, top with the eggs, sesame seeds and remaining spring onions.

name: Pad see ew
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions, drain and toss with a little oil.
Mix the dark soy, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar.
Stir-fry the chicken and garlic in oil in a hot wok for 4 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs, then add the broccoli and a splash of water and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until slightly charred.

name: Thai basil chicken
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the garlic and chillies for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken mince and stir-fry for 5 minutes until cooked, breaking it up.
Add the pepper and green beans and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and a splash of water.
Take off the heat, stir through the basil and serve with rice.

name: Vietnamese pho
ingredients: 300g beef sirloin steak, very thinly sliced
steps: Char the onion and ginger under a hot grill for 5 minutes.
Simmer the stock with the onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, fish sauce and sugar for 30 minutes, then strain.
Cook the noodles to the pack instructions and divide between bowls.
Top with the raw beef slices and spring onions.
Ladle over the boiling broth so it cooks the beef, then add beansprouts, coriander, chilli and lime.

name: Banh mi
steps: Marinate the pork in the soy sauce, honey and garlic for 15 minutes.
Mix the carrot with the vinegar and sugar and leave to quick pickle.
Fry the pork in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked and caramelised.
Split the baguettes and warm in the oven for 3 minutes. Spread with mayonnaise.
Fill with the pork, pickled carrot, cucumber, chilli and coriander.

name: Vietnamese summer rolls
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, drain and rinse in cold water.
Dip one rice paper in warm water for 10 seconds until pliable and lay on a damp board.
Place the lettuce, noodles, carrot, cucumber, herbs and a few prawns near the bottom edge.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat with the rest.
Warm the peanut butter, hoisin, chilli sauce and 3 tbsp water until smooth for dipping.

name: Bao buns
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder, milk and oil into a dough and knead for 8 minutes. Cover and prove for 1 hour.
Meanwhile roast the pork belly with the soy sauce at 180C for 40 minutes, then brush with hoisin and cook for 10 minutes more.
Divide the dough into 8, roll into ovals and fold over, resting on squares of baking paper.
Prove for 20 minutes, then steam for 10 minutes until puffed and soft.
Fill with sliced pork, cucumber and spring onions.

name: Dan dan noodles
steps: Fry the pork mince in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and 1 tbsp soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk the remaining soy, tahini, chilli oil, vinegar, sugar and 4 tbsp water into a sauce.
Cook the noodles and pak choi together for 3 minutes and drain.
Toss the noodles in the sauce, top with pork, spring onions and peanuts.

name: Chilli garlic noodles
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions, drain and keep a little cooking water.
Gently fry the garlic and chillies in the oil for 2 minutes until golden but not burnt.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and a splash of cooking water.
Toss in the noodles and sesame oil until glossy.
Top with spring onions and serve.

name: Honey garlic chicken
ingredients: 700g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, diced
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the honey, soy sauce, vinegar and ketchup and bubble for 3 to 4 minutes until sticky.
Serve with rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: General Tso's chicken
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, cut into chunks
steps: Dip the chicken in the egg and coat in the cornflour.
Fry in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and golden. Drain on kitchen paper.
Fry the chillies, garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, hoisin and 100ml water and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce, scatter with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Mongolian beef
ingredients: 1 bunch spring onions, cut into 4cm lengths
steps: Toss the beef in the cornflour, shaking off the excess.
Fry in 2 tbsp hot oil in batches for 2 minutes until crisp, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar, hoisin and 100ml water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return the beef with the spring onions and toss until the sauce is sticky. Serve with rice.

name: Chicken lo mein
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until cooked, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot, mushrooms, cabbage and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, chicken, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil.
Toss for 2 minutes until hot and finish with spring onions.

name: Prawn fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool.
Stir-fry the prawns in 1 tbsp oil for 2 to 3 minutes until pink, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and peas and cook for 1 minute, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the cold rice and soy sauce and stir-fry over a high heat for 3 minutes.
Return the prawns, add the sesame oil and spring onions and toss.

name: Chicken fried noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and rinse under cold water.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, onion, pepper and garlic and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, chicken, beansprouts, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes, drizzle with the sesame oil and serve.

name: Hoisin duck wraps
steps: Score the duck skin and rub with the five spice and a pinch of salt.
Place skin side down in a cold frying pan, heat gently and cook for 8 minutes until the fat renders and skin is crisp.
Turn and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Warm the tortillas and mix the hoisin with the soy sauce.
Spread each wrap with hoisin, add the duck, cucumber and spring onions and roll up.

name: Chinese chicken curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the stock, soy sauce and sugar until smooth.
Add the chicken and carrot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the peas, cook for 3 minutes and serve with rice.

name: Chinese pork belly
steps: Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes and drain.
Heat the oil with the sugar in a pan until it caramelises to amber.
Add the pork and stir to coat, then add the soy sauces, vinegar, garlic, ginger, star anise and enough water to just cover.
Simmer gently with the lid ajar for 1 hour 30 minutes until tender.
Reduce the sauce uncovered until sticky and serve with rice and spring onions.

name: Tofu with black bean sauce
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornflour.
Fry in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until golden on all sides, then remove.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion, garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for 3 minutes.
Add the black bean sauce, soy sauce and stock and simmer for 3 minutes.
Return the tofu, toss gently and top with spring onions. Serve with rice.

name: Sticky chicken wings
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and roast the wings on a lined tray for 25 minutes.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, garlic, ginger and five spice.
Toss the wings in half the sauce and roast for 15 minutes.
Turn, brush with the remaining sauce and roast for 10 minutes until dark and sticky.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Korean beef bowls
steps: Cook the rice to the pack instructions.
Brown the mince in the oil for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar, gochujang and sesame oil and cook for 3 minutes until sticky.
Serve over the rice with cucumber, spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the pepper, mangetout, carrot, garlic and ginger and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes until piping hot.

name: Tonkatsu
steps: Bash the pork steaks until 1cm thick and season with salt and pepper.
Coat in the flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in 1cm hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on kitchen paper and slice into strips.
Serve on rice with the cabbage, tonkatsu sauce and lemon.

name: Oyakodon
ingredients: 3 chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, sliced
steps: Cook the rice to the pack instructions.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a frying pan.
Add the onion and chicken and cook for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Pour the egg over in a thin stream, cover and cook for 2 minutes until just set.
Slide over rice in bowls and top with spring onions.

name: Gyudon
ingredients: 300g beef rump steak, very thinly sliced
steps: Cook the rice to the pack instructions.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger in a pan.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the beef and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until just done.
Serve over rice in bowls, topped with a soft-boiled or raw egg yolk and spring onions.

name: Yaki udon
steps: Loosen the udon in hot water for 1 minute and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked.
Add the onion, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and mirin and toss for 3 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onions.

name: Okonomiyaki
steps: Whisk the flour, water and eggs into a batter and fold in the cabbage and spring onions.
Heat half the oil in a frying pan and pour in half the mixture.
Lay three rashers on top and cook for 5 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip and cook for 5 more minutes until the bacon is crisp and the middle is cooked. Repeat for the second pancake.
Brush with tonkatsu sauce, drizzle with mayonnaise and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Tempura prawns
ingredients: 16 raw king prawns, peeled with tails on
steps: Heat 5cm of oil in a deep pan to 180C.
Whisk the flour, cornflour, baking powder and sparkling water lightly, leaving a few lumps.
Dip the prawns in the batter and fry in batches for 2 minutes until pale golden and crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper.
Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for dipping and serve with lemon.

name: Chicken karaage
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, cut into chunks
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, mirin, garlic and ginger for 20 minutes.
Heat 5cm of oil in a deep pan to 170C.
Drain the chicken and coat in the cornflour.
Fry in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Drain and serve with mayonnaise and lemon.

name: Chicken udon soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the soy sauce, mirin and ginger.
Add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and pak choi and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the udon and heat for 2 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onions.

name: Kimchi jjigae
steps: Fry the pork in the oil for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the kimchi, onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang and soy sauce, then add the stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes, then top with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Japchae
steps: Cook the noodles for 6 minutes, drain, rinse and cut into shorter lengths.
Marinate the beef in 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil and the garlic.
Stir-fry the carrot, onion and mushrooms in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, then wilt the spinach.
Cook the beef for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toss everything with the noodles, remaining soy, sesame oil and sugar and top with sesame seeds.

name: Tteokbokki
steps: Soak the rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes if they are hard, then drain.
Bring the stock, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, chilli flakes and garlic to a simmer.
Add the rice cakes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring often, until soft and the sauce is thick.
Stir in most of the spring onions and the sesame oil.
Serve topped with the eggs and remaining spring onions.

name: Kimchi pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, cornflour, water and kimchi juice into a batter.
Fold in the kimchi and spring onions.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and spread half the batter thinly. Cook for 4 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook for 3 minutes. Repeat with the rest.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame seeds for dipping.

name: Thai peanut noodles
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions, drain and rinse.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, garlic and 3 tbsp warm water.
Toss the noodles with the sauce.
Mix through the pepper, carrot and most of the spring onions.
Top with peanuts and remaining spring onions.

name: Thai red chicken curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes to coat.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and green beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and top with coriander. Serve with rice.

name: Tom yum soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the tom yum paste, lemongrass and lime leaves for 10 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve topped with chilli and coriander.

name: Massaman beef curry
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onion and curry paste for 2 minutes.
Return the beef and add the coconut milk and stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes, fish sauce, sugar and tamarind and cook for 25 minutes. Serve with rice and peanuts.

name: Thai fishcakes
steps: Blitz the fish, curry paste, egg, fish sauce and cornflour to a coarse paste.
Stir in the green beans and coriander.
Shape into 12 small patties with wet hands.
Fry in 1cm of hot oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Thai fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until cooked.
Add the garlic and pepper and cook for 2 minutes, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice, fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the spring onions, finish with lime juice and serve.

name: Drunken noodles
steps: Cook the noodles to the pack instructions and drain.
Fry the garlic and chillies in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the pepper and onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar and toss for 2 minutes, then stir in the basil.

name: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, sliced
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce and chilli.
Marinate the chicken in the mixture for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice to the pack instructions.
Fry the chicken in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and caramelised.
Serve over rice with cucumber and coriander.

name: Vietnamese beef noodle salad
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, drain and rinse in cold water.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and chilli into a dressing.
Fry the steak in the oil for 3 minutes each side, rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Divide the noodles, carrot, cucumber and herbs between bowls.
Top with the steak, spoon over the dressing and scatter with peanuts.

name: Egg foo yung
steps: Beat the eggs with 1 tsp soy sauce and fold in the beansprouts, prawns and spring onions.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and pour in a quarter of the mixture to make small omelettes.
Cook for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Heat the stock, soy sauce and oyster sauce, then stir in the cornflour mixed with water and simmer until thick.
Pour the gravy over the omelettes and serve.

name: Chicken chop suey
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Stir-fry in 1 tbsp hot oil for 5 minutes, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion, carrot, pepper, mushrooms and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the beansprouts, soy sauce, oyster sauce and stock.
Return the chicken, simmer for 3 minutes until lightly thickened and serve with rice.

name: Mapo tofu
steps: Fry the pork in the oil for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and chilli bean paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add the tofu gently and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour mixed with water to thicken, then add the sesame oil and spring onions. Serve with rice.

name: Orange chicken
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, cut into chunks
steps: Dip the chicken in the egg and coat in the 80g cornflour.
Fry in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp. Drain.
Simmer the orange juice and zest, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Stir in the 1 tsp cornflour mixed with water and cook until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and top with spring onions. Serve with rice.

name: Sweet chilli chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Stir-fry in the oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the pepper, onion, mangetout and garlic and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce and lime juice and bubble for 2 minutes.
Serve with rice or noodles.

name: Chicken fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until cooked.
Add the remaining oil, carrot, peas and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the spring onions and sesame oil and toss.

name: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool.
Stir-fry the pepper, carrot, peas, sweetcorn and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the spring onions and sesame oil and toss.

name: Prawn chow mein
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with sesame oil.
Stir-fry the prawns in 1 tbsp oil for 2 to 3 minutes, then remove.
Stir-fry the pepper, carrot and garlic in the remaining oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beansprouts, noodles, soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Return the prawns, toss for 2 minutes and top with spring onions.

name: Vegetable chow mein
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir-fry the carrot, pepper, mushrooms, cabbage and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beansprouts and cook for 1 minute.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes and serve.

name: Teriyaki beef
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, mirin, garlic and ginger.
Toss the beef in the cornflour and sear in 1 tbsp hot oil for 2 minutes, then remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the remaining oil with a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and bubble for 2 minutes until glossy.
Return the beef and toss. Serve with rice and sesame seeds.

name: Chinese salt and pepper squid
steps: Pat the squid dry. Mix the cornflour, five spice, half the salt and pepper and toss the squid through.
Fry in hot oil in batches for 2 minutes until crisp, then drain.
Stir-fry the chilli, garlic and spring onions in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute.
Add the squid and remaining salt and toss.
Serve with lemon wedges and sweet chilli sauce.

name: Sweet and sour prawns
