ingredients: 1 x 227g tin pineapple chunks in juice, drained (keep juice)
steps: Dip the prawns in the egg and coat in the cornflour.
Fry in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and 4 tbsp pineapple juice.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion for 3 minutes, then add the sauce and pineapple and bubble for 2 minutes.
Toss the prawns through and serve with rice.

name: Crispy seaweed
steps: Remove the thick stalks from the spring greens, roll up the leaves and shred as thinly as possible.
Dry thoroughly on kitchen paper.
Fry in small batches in 2cm hot oil for 30 to 60 seconds until crisp and dark green. Take care as it spits.
Drain on kitchen paper.
Toss with the salt, sugar and five spice and scatter with the almonds.

name: Chinese barbecue spare ribs
steps: Mix the hoisin, soy sauce, honey, ketchup, vinegar, garlic, ginger and five spice.
Coat the ribs and marinate for at least 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 160C. Wrap the ribs in foil on a tray and roast for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Unwrap, brush with the remaining marinade and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

name: Egg and tomato stir-fry
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp hot oil until just set and remove.
Add the remaining oil and cook the tomatoes for 3 to 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the sugar and soy sauce.
Return the eggs, add the sesame oil and spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Garlic pak choi
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and fry the garlic for 30 seconds until golden.
Add the pak choi and a splash of water and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve.

name: Chinese chip shop curry sauce
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and roast the chips in oil for 35 minutes.
Fry the onion in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until very soft.
Add the garlic, curry powder, turmeric and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the stock, sugar and soy sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blitz until smooth if you like, and pour over the chips.

name: Szechuan beef
steps: Toss the beef in the cornflour.
Sear in 2 tbsp very hot oil for 2 minutes, then remove.
Fry the pepper, onion, garlic, ginger and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chilli bean paste, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the beef, toss and top with spring onions. Serve with rice.

name: Twice-cooked pork
steps: Simmer the pork belly in water for 30 minutes until tender, then cool and slice thinly.
Stir-fry the slices in a dry hot wok for 4 minutes until the edges curl and crisp.
Add the oil, pepper, leek and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the chilli bean paste, soy sauce and sugar.
Toss for 2 minutes, top with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Ginger and spring onion chicken
ingredients: 600g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, sliced
1 bunch spring onions, cut into 4cm lengths
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour.
Fry in 2 tbsp hot oil for 6 minutes until golden, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the spring onions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the chicken, toss for 2 minutes, add sesame oil and serve with rice.

name: Tomato soup
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 8 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, then add the chopped tomatoes, stock cube, sugar and 300ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season and serve hot with crusty bread.

name: Carrot and coriander soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and ground coriander and cook for 2 minutes.
Crumble in the stock cube, add 800ml water and simmer for 20 minutes until the carrots are tender.
Add most of the fresh coriander and blend until smooth.
Season and serve topped with the remaining coriander.

name: Butternut squash soup
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the squash in 1 tbsp oil, season and roast for 30 minutes.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes, adding the garlic and cumin for the last minute.
Add the roasted squash, stock cube and 700ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, adjust the seasoning and swirl in the cream to serve.

name: Minestrone soup
steps: Heat the oil and gently cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, stock cube and 1 litre water, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the courgette, beans and pasta and cook for 10 minutes more.
Season, stir through the basil and serve with grated cheese if you like.

name: French onion soup
steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a large pan, add the onions and cook slowly for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden.
Add the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Crumble in the stock cube, add 1 litre water and the Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toast the bread, pour the soup into ovenproof bowls and top with the toast and cheese.
Grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes.
Add the stock cubes and 1.2 litres water and bring to the boil.
Add the chicken and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes.
Season and stir through the parsley.

name: Chicken and vegetable soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrots, potatoes and leek for 8 minutes.
Add the whole chicken breasts, stock cube, thyme and 1.2 litres water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pan with the peas.
Cook for 5 minutes, season and serve.

name: Lentil soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrots for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the lentils, stock cube and 1.2 litres water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend partly if you like it thicker, then add the lemon juice and season.

name: Mushroom soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion for 5 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes until golden.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock cube and 600ml water.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream, season and sprinkle with parsley.

name: Broccoli and Stilton soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the potato, stock cube and 800ml water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook for 6 minutes until tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in most of the Stilton until melted.
Season lightly and serve topped with the remaining cheese.

name: Cream of chicken soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion and celery for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add 800ml water mixed with the stock cube, stirring until thickened.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Add the chicken and cream, heat through gently and season.

name: Sweet potato soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes, adding the garlic and cumin for the last minute.
Add the sweet potatoes, stock cube and 600ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and blend until smooth.
Season and reheat gently before serving.

name: Spicy parsnip soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the parsnips and curry powder and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the stock cube and 900ml water and simmer for 25 minutes until the parsnips are very soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.

name: Cauliflower cheese soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, stock cube and 500ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the milk and blend until smooth.
Return to a low heat, stir in 100g of the cheese and the mustard until melted.
Season and top with the remaining cheese.

name: Roasted red pepper soup
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the peppers, onion and garlic in the oil on a tray and roast for 30 minutes.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins into a pan with the roasted vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, stock cube, paprika and 400ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season and serve.

name: Watercress soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the potato, stock cube and 700ml water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the watercress and cook for 2 minutes only to keep it bright.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.

name: Pea and mint soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the potato, stock cube and 700ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the peas and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the mint, blend until smooth and season to taste.

name: Thai chicken soup
steps: Heat the oil and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, stock cube and 400ml water and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Serve scattered with coriander.

name: Oxtail soup
steps: Toss the oxtail in the flour and brown in the oil in a large pan, then set aside.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes, then stir in the tomato puree.
Return the oxtail, add the stock cube, bay leaves, Worcestershire sauce and 1.5 litres water.
Simmer very gently for 3 hours until the meat falls from the bone.
Remove the bones and bay leaves, shred the meat back into the soup and season.

name: Beef and barley soup
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a large pan, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, swede, barley, tomato puree, stock cube, bay leaves and 1.5 litres water.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes until the beef and barley are tender.
Remove the bay leaves, season and serve.

name: Tomato and basil soup
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the tomatoes, onion and garlic in the oil for 30 minutes.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins and tip everything into a pan with the stock cube and 400ml water.
Simmer for 10 minutes, add the basil and blend until smooth.
Season, swirl in the cream and serve.

name: Courgette soup
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the courgettes, potato, stock cube and 700ml water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in half the parmesan and season.
Serve with the rest of the parmesan on top.

name: Celery soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion and celery for 10 minutes.
Add the potato, stock cube and 700ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the milk.
Season generously and reheat gently.

name: Caesar salad
steps: Season the chicken and cook in the oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Toast the bread cubes in a dry pan or oven at 200C for 8 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise, garlic, lemon juice, anchovies and 1 tbsp water into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, then top with the chicken, croutons and parmesan.

name: Greek salad
steps: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano together and season.
Toss the salad with the dressing, then top with the feta.

name: Nicoise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and quarter.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard into a dressing.
Arrange the potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna, eggs and anchovies on a platter and drizzle with the dressing.

name: Waldorf salad
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt and lemon juice in a large bowl.
Add the apples, celery, walnuts and grapes and toss to coat.
Serve spooned onto the lettuce leaves.

name: Potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until tender, then drain and cool for 10 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt and mustard together.
Fold the potatoes and spring onions through the dressing.
Season, scatter with chives and chill until needed.

name: Pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the packet, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the oil and vinegar together and season.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes, cucumber, sweetcorn and olives.
Stir in the dressing and basil.

name: Couscous salad
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl with the crumbled stock cube and pour over 250ml boiling water.
Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the pepper, cucumber, spring onions and mint.
Dress with the lemon juice and oil and season.

name: Rice salad
steps: Cook the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard together.
Mix the rice with the sweetcorn, pepper and spring onions, then toss through the dressing.

name: Chicken salad
steps: Season the chicken and cook in 1 tbsp oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Arrange the salad leaves, tomatoes, cucumber and avocado on plates.
Top with the chicken and drizzle with the lemon juice and remaining oil.

name: Tuna salad
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and quarter.
Divide the salad leaves, tomatoes, cucumber and sweetcorn between two plates.
Flake over the tuna and add the eggs.
Whisk the oil and lemon juice, season and drizzle over.

name: Beetroot and goat's cheese salad
steps: Whisk the oil, balsamic vinegar and honey together and season.
Arrange the rocket on a platter and top with the beetroot.
Scatter over the goat's cheese and walnuts.
Drizzle with the dressing and serve.

name: Halloumi salad
steps: Fry the halloumi in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Combine the salad leaves, cucumber, tomatoes and onion on plates.
Whisk the lemon juice, remaining oil and mint together.
Top the salad with the warm halloumi and drizzle over the dressing.

name: Cobb salad
steps: Grill the bacon until crisp, then crumble. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and chop.
Season the chicken and cook in 1 tbsp oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side, then rest and dice.
Whisk the remaining oil and vinegar into a dressing.
Arrange the lettuce on a platter in rows with the chicken, bacon, eggs, tomatoes, avocado and Stilton.
Drizzle with the dressing at the table.

name: Egg salad
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, then peel and roughly chop.
Mix the mayonnaise and mustard in a bowl.
Fold in the eggs, celery and spring onions and season.
Serve on the salad leaves topped with chives.

name: Bean salad
steps: Rinse the beans and chickpeas and put them in a large bowl.
Add the onion, tomatoes and parsley.
Whisk the oil and vinegar together, season and toss through the salad.
Leave for 15 minutes so the flavours mingle.

name: Quinoa salad
steps: Cook the quinoa with the stock cube in 450ml water for 12 to 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and leave to cool for 10 minutes.
Stir in the pepper, cucumber, tomatoes and parsley.
Whisk the lemon juice and oil, dress the salad and top with feta.

name: Sausage sandwich
steps: Grill or fry the sausages for 15 to 18 minutes, turning often, until golden and cooked through.
Slice the sausages in half lengthways.
Butter the bread, fill with sausages and add ketchup and mustard.

name: BLT sandwich
steps: Grill the bacon until crisp and toast the bread.
Spread the toast with mayonnaise.
Layer the lettuce, tomato and bacon on two slices, season and top with the remaining toast.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Club sandwich
steps: Grill the bacon until crisp, fry the eggs and toast the bread.
Spread mayonnaise on all the toast.
Layer chicken, lettuce and tomato on two slices, top with a second slice, then the bacon and egg.
Finish with the last slices, secure with cocktail sticks and cut into quarters.

name: Tuna mayo sandwich
steps: Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise and spring onion and season.
Butter the bread.
Spread the tuna mixture on two slices and top with the remaining bread.

name: Egg mayo sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise and season well.
Butter the bread, spread the egg on two slices and sandwich together.

name: Cheese and pickle sandwich
steps: Butter the bread.
Layer the cheddar over two slices and spread with pickle.
Top with the remaining bread and cut in half.

name: Ham and mustard sandwich
steps: Butter the bread and spread two slices with mustard.
Fold the ham over the mustard and add the lettuce.
Top with the remaining bread and cut in half.

name: Coronation chicken sandwich
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, chutney, curry powder and yoghurt into a sauce.
Fold in the chicken and almonds.
Butter the bread, fill four slices with the chicken mixture and top with the remaining slices.

name: Prawn mayo sandwich
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and lemon juice, then fold in the prawns.
Butter the bread and add the lettuce to two slices.
Spoon over the prawns and top with the remaining bread.

name: Chicken mayo sandwich
steps: Mix the chicken, mayonnaise and celery and season.
Butter the bread.
Spread the chicken mixture on two slices and top with the rest.

name: Cheese toastie
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Put two slices butter side down in a frying pan, top with cheese and mustard, then the other slices butter side up.
Cook over a medium heat for 3 minutes each side, pressing down, until golden and melted.

name: Ham and cheese toastie
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread and spread the other with mustard.
Fill two slices with ham and cheddar and top with the rest, butter side out.
Fry over a medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted.

name: Tuna melt
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise and spring onions.
Butter one side of each slice of bread and put two slices butter side down in a frying pan.
Top with the tuna mixture and cheddar, then the remaining slices butter side up.
Cook for 3 minutes each side until golden and melted.

name: Croque monsieur
steps: Melt half the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Add the nutmeg and a third of the cheese.
Spread the bread with mustard and make two sandwiches with the ham and half the remaining cheese.
Heat the oven to 220C. Fry the sandwiches in the remaining butter for 2 minutes each side.
Place on a tray, spoon over the sauce, top with the last of the cheese and bake for 8 minutes until golden.

name: Poached eggs on toast
steps: Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar.
Swirl the water, crack in the eggs one at a time and poach for 3 minutes.
Toast and butter the bread, top with the drained eggs and season.

name: Mushrooms on toast
steps: Melt the butter in a large frying pan and cook the mushrooms over a high heat for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cream and parsley and season.
Toast the bread and spoon the mushrooms on top.

name: Sardines on toast
ingredients: 2 x 120g tins sardines in oil, drained
steps: Toast the bread and butter it.
Top with the tomato slices and the sardines.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and season with plenty of black pepper.

name: Avocado toast
steps: Toast the sourdough.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and season well.
Spread over the toast, drizzle with the oil and top with chilli.

name: Chip butty
ingredients: 600g potatoes, peeled and cut into chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the chips in the oil and bake on a tray for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Butter the bread generously.
Pile the hot chips onto two slices, season with salt and add sauce.
Top with the remaining bread.

name: Crisp sandwich
steps: Butter the bread generously.
Pile the crisps onto two slices and press down gently.
Top with the other slices and cut in half.

name: Cheese and ham panini
steps: Heat a griddle or frying pan.
Spread the cut sides of the ciabatta with mustard and fill with ham, mozzarella and tomato.
Brush the outsides with oil and cook for 3 to 4 minutes each side, pressing down with a heavy pan, until golden and melted.

name: Steak sandwich
steps: Fry the onion in the butter for 10 minutes until soft and golden, then set aside.
Season the steaks and fry in the oil over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes each side for medium.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Toast the rolls, spread with horseradish and fill with rocket, steak and onions.

name: Chicken wrap
steps: Toss the chicken in the oil and paprika and fry for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Warm the wraps, spread with the mayonnaise and fill with lettuce, tomato and chicken.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

name: Tortilla wraps with hummus
steps: Spread each wrap with hummus.
Layer the carrot, cucumber, pepper and rocket down the middle.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly, then cut in half.

name: Tuna mayo jacket potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake for 1 hour 10 minutes.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, sweetcorn and spring onions.
Split the potatoes and fill with the tuna mixture.

name: Cheese and coleslaw jacket potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake for 1 hour 10 minutes.
Split open and fluff the insides with the butter.
Top with the cheddar, letting it melt, then spoon over the coleslaw.

name: Chilli jacket potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and bake for 1 hour 10 minutes.
Brown the mince with the onion in a pan for 8 minutes.
Add the chilli powder, tomatoes and kidney beans and simmer for 20 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar.

name: Prawn jacket potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and bake for 1 hour 10 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and lemon juice and fold in the prawns.
Split the potatoes, add the lettuce and spoon over the prawns.
Dust with paprika.

name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Roll out the pastry to line a 23cm tin, prick the base and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without the paper.
Fry the bacon and onion for 8 minutes until golden and scatter in the case with the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, cream and milk with seasoning and pour in.
Reduce to 180C and bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.
Cool slightly before slicing.

name: Cheese and onion quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 23cm tin with the pastry and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without the paper.
Cook the onions in the butter for 15 minutes until soft and sweet.
Spread the onions and half the cheddar in the case.
Whisk the eggs, cream, mustard and seasoning, pour in and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until set and golden.

name: Frittata
steps: Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and peas and cook for 3 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the cheddar and seasoning and pour into the pan.
Cook over a low heat for 5 minutes, then grill for 4 minutes until set and golden.
Cut into wedges.

name: Spanish omelette
steps: Heat the oil in a 24cm non-stick frying pan and cook the potatoes and onion gently for 15 minutes until soft but not browned.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and stir in the potato mixture.
Tip back into the pan and cook over a low heat for 8 minutes until almost set.
Slide onto a plate, flip back into the pan and cook for 3 minutes more.
Serve warm or cold in wedges.

name: Scotch pancakes
steps: Mix the flour and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk in the egg, milk and melted butter to a thick batter.
Heat a frying pan with a little butter and drop in tablespoons of batter.
Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Serve warm with butter or jam.

name: Hummus and pitta
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and cumin with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Season with salt and loosen with more water if needed.
Warm the pitta breads under the grill and cut into strips for dipping.

name: Irish soda bread
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and dust a tray with flour.
Mix the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a bowl.
Stir in the buttermilk to make a soft dough, then shape into a round on the tray.
Cut a deep cross in the top and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped.
Cool on a wire rack.

name: Cheese omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a small frying pan until foaming and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently with a fork for 1 minute until the base sets.
Scatter over the cheese, fold in half and slide onto a plate.

name: Egg and cress sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise and season.
Butter the bread, spread the egg on two slices and top with cress.
Close with the remaining slices.

name: Cucumber sandwiches
steps: Butter all the bread slices.
Layer the cucumber over four slices and season with salt and pepper.
Top with the remaining slices, trim off the crusts and cut into triangles.

name: Boiled eggs and soldiers
steps: Bring a pan of water to the boil and lower in the eggs gently.
Cook for 5 to 6 minutes for a runny yolk.
Toast and butter the bread and cut into soldiers.
Serve the eggs in egg cups with salt and pepper.

name: Smoked salmon and cream cheese bagel
steps: Toast the bagels.
Spread the cut sides with cream cheese.
Fold the salmon over the bases, add the capers and a squeeze of lemon.
Season with black pepper and close the bagels.

name: Vegetable soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrots, potatoes and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock cube and 1 litre water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5.
Season and serve with bread.

name: Tomato and mozzarella salad
steps: Arrange the tomatoes and mozzarella in overlapping layers on a plate.
Tuck in the basil leaves.
Drizzle with the oil and balsamic vinegar and season.

name: Prawn and avocado salad
steps: Arrange the rocket, tomatoes and avocado on plates.
Scatter over the prawns.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and chilli and drizzle over the salad.

name: Chicken and bacon salad
steps: Grill the bacon until crisp and chop. Season the chicken and cook in 1 tbsp oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side, then slice.
Whisk the remaining oil, mustard and vinegar.
Toss the leaves and tomatoes with half the dressing and top with avocado, chicken and bacon.
Drizzle over the rest of the dressing.

name: Cheese scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray. Rub the butter into the flour and baking powder until like breadcrumbs.
Stir in 75g of the cheddar and the mustard powder.
Beat the egg with the milk, reserving a little, and mix into a soft dough.
Pat out to 3cm thick, cut into rounds and place on the tray.
Brush with the reserved egg mix, top with the remaining cheddar and bake for 12 minutes.

name: Cheese straws
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the pastry with mustard and scatter over half the cheddar.
Fold over, roll lightly and cut into thin strips.
Twist the strips and place on a lined tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and paprika.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden and puffed.

name: Cheese and onion pasty
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Soften the onions and potato in the butter for 8 minutes and cool.
Stir in the cheddar and season.
Cut four 18cm circles from the pastry and pile the filling in the centre.
Fold over, crimp the edges and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Sweetcorn fritters
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs and milk into a thick batter and season.
Stir in the sweetcorn and spring onions.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and drop in spoonfuls of batter.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve warm.

name: Spaghetti on toast
ingredients: 1 x 400g tin spaghetti in tomato sauce
steps: Heat the spaghetti in a small pan for 4 minutes.
Toast and butter the bread.
Spoon the spaghetti over and top with cheddar.

name: Corned beef sandwich
steps: Butter the bread.
Layer the corned beef and tomato on two slices and spread with pickle.
Top with the remaining bread and cut in half.

name: Ham salad
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and quarter.
Arrange the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and spring onions on plates.
Fold the ham over the salad and add the eggs.
Serve with salad cream.

name: Salmon and broccoli quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 23cm tin with the pastry and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without the paper.
Poach the salmon in simmering water for 6 minutes, flake and blanch the broccoli for 2 minutes.
Scatter the salmon, broccoli and half the cheddar into the case.
Whisk the eggs, cream and seasoning, pour in and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until set.

name: Smoked mackerel pate on toast
steps: Flake the mackerel into a bowl, discarding any bones.
Mash in the cream cheese, lemon juice and horseradish and season with pepper.
Toast the bread and cut into triangles.
Spread the pate over the toast and top with chives.

name: Porridge
steps: Put the oats, milk, water and salt in a saucepan.
Heat gently, stirring often, for 5 to 6 minutes until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with honey and sliced banana.

name: Overnight oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yoghurt, honey and vanilla in a bowl.
Divide between two jars, cover and chill overnight.
Stir in the morning and top with blueberries.

name: Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 160C and line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Mix the oats, nuts, seeds and cinnamon in a bowl.
Warm the oil and honey together, pour over the oat mix and stir well.
Spread on the tray and bake for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Leave to cool completely, then stir in the raisins and store in a jar.

name: Bircher muesli
steps: Mix the oats and apple juice in a bowl and leave for 10 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt, grated apple and honey.
Chill overnight if you have time.
Serve topped with hazelnuts and blueberries.

name: Scrambled eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula until just set but still creamy.
Meanwhile toast the bread and serve the eggs on top.

name: Fried eggs
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat.
Crack in the eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, spooning the hot oil over the whites.
Toast and butter the bread.
Serve the eggs on the toast, seasoned with salt and pepper.

name: Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a small non-stick frying pan until foaming.
Pour in the eggs and stir briefly, then leave to set for a minute.
Fold the omelette in half and slide onto a plate.

name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Whisk the egg yolks and lemon juice in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water.
Slowly whisk in the melted butter until thick, then season and keep warm.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast the muffins and top each half with ham, an egg and a spoonful of hollandaise.

name: Eggs Florentine
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan, squeeze out the water and season.
Whisk the egg yolks and lemon juice over barely simmering water, then slowly whisk in the melted butter until thick.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast the muffins, then top with spinach, an egg and hollandaise.

name: Eggs royale
steps: Whisk the egg yolks and lemon juice over barely simmering water, then slowly whisk in the melted butter until thick.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast the muffins and layer on the smoked salmon.
Top with the eggs, spoon over the hollandaise and scatter with chives.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and soften the onion and pepper for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for a minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make six dips in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set, then scatter with coriander.

name: American pancakes
steps: Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk and melted butter together and stir into the flour until just combined.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick frying pan and drop in ladlefuls of batter.
Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook for 1 more minute.
Stack and serve with maple syrup.

name: Crepes
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, oil and salt into a smooth thin batter.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan and swirl in a thin layer of batter.
Cook for 1 minute each side until golden, stacking the crepes on a plate.
Serve with lemon juice and caster sugar.

name: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Dip each slice of bread in the egg mixture until soaked.
Melt the butter in a frying pan and fry the bread for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Serve drizzled with maple syrup and topped with strawberries.

name: Eggy bread
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper in a shallow dish.
Soak each slice of bread in the egg for 20 seconds each side.
Heat the butter and oil in a frying pan and fry the bread for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Cut into fingers and serve with ketchup.

name: Waffles
steps: Heat a waffle iron.
Mix the flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla together and stir into the dry ingredients.
Ladle batter into the waffle iron and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp.
Serve with strawberries and maple syrup.

name: Breakfast burrito
steps: Grill or fry the bacon until crisp, then chop.
Scramble the eggs in the oiled pan over a low heat and season.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill with eggs, bacon, cheddar and salsa, then fold in the sides and roll up.

name: Bacon and egg muffin
steps: Grill the bacon for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toast and butter the muffins.
Fill each muffin with bacon and an egg, and add ketchup.

name: Sausage and egg muffin
steps: Grill the sausages for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toast and butter the muffins.
Slice the sausages in half lengthways and layer in the muffins with an egg and a slice of cheddar.

name: Hash browns
steps: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a tea towel.
Mix with the onion, egg, flour, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and shape the mix into 8 flat patties.
Fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.

name: Smoked salmon and scrambled eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and a little pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a low heat and add the eggs.
Stir gently until softly set, then take off the heat.
Toast the bread, pile on the eggs, top with smoked salmon and chives.

name: Veggie breakfast
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and roast the sausages on a tray for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and mushrooms with half the oil and roast for another 10 minutes.
Heat the beans in a pan and fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Toast the bread and serve everything together.

name: Breakfast smoothie
steps: Peel the bananas and break into chunks.
Put everything in a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth and pour into glasses.

name: Banana smoothie
steps: Peel the bananas and slice them into the blender.
Add the milk, yoghurt, honey and ice.
Blend until smooth and serve straight away.

name: Berry smoothie
steps: Put the berries, banana, yoghurt and orange juice into a blender.
Add the honey and blend for 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve.

name: Fruit salad
steps: Put all the chopped fruit into a large bowl.
Mix the lime juice and honey and pour over the fruit.
Toss gently and chill for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Yoghurt and fruit pots
steps: Layer a spoonful of yoghurt into four glasses or jars.
Add a layer of strawberries and blueberries.
Repeat the layers and finish with granola.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Breakfast muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 190C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with cases.
Mix the flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla together and stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Fold in the blueberries and spoon into the cases.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes until risen and golden.

name: Cinnamon toast
steps: Heat the grill to high.
Mix the butter, sugar and cinnamon into a paste.
Toast the bread on one side under the grill, turn and spread the paste on the untoasted side.
Grill for 1 to 2 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Toasted crumpets with butter and honey
steps: Toast the crumpets until golden.
Spread generously with butter while hot.
Top with honey and sliced banana.

name: Bagel with cream cheese
steps: Toast the bagels until golden.
Spread both halves with cream cheese.
Top with smoked salmon, a squeeze of lemon, chives and pepper.

name: Avocado and egg toast
steps: Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast the sourdough and spread with the avocado.
Top with the eggs and chilli flakes.

name: Breakfast hash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes and drain well.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the sausage, onion and pepper for 8 minutes.
Add the potatoes and paprika and fry for 10 minutes until crisp.
Make four gaps, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes until set.

name: Fish fingers, chips and peas
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the chips in the oil and spread on a tray, then bake for 35 minutes, turning once.
Add the fish fingers to a second tray for the last 15 to 18 minutes, turning halfway.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes, drain and stir through the butter.
Serve with lemon wedges and ketchup.

name: Chicken nuggets and chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the chips in the oil and bake on a tray for 35 minutes, turning once.
Put the nuggets on another tray and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once.
Boil the sweetcorn for 3 minutes and drain.
Serve together with ketchup.

name: Homemade chicken nuggets
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and oil a baking tray.
Blitz the chicken in a food processor until finely chopped, then shape into small nuggets.
Dip each nugget in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumbs mixed with the garlic powder, paprika and seasoning.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

name: Homemade fish fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and oil a baking tray.
Season the flour, then dip each finger of fish in the flour, the egg and the breadcrumbs.
Lay on the tray and drizzle with the oil.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Cheesy pasta
steps: Cook the macaroni according to the pack and drain.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for a minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened.
Stir in the cheddar and mustard until melted, then season.
Mix in the pasta and serve.

name: Pasta with hidden veg sauce
steps: Cook the penne according to the pack.
Heat the oil and soften the onion, carrots and courgette for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomatoes and puree and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth, then toss with the drained pasta.
Serve topped with cheddar.

name: Tomato pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti according to the pack.
Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the basil, toss with the pasta and top with cheddar.

name: Mini pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toast the muffin halves lightly and spread each with tomato puree.
Top with mozzarella, sweetcorn and oregano and drizzle with oil.
Bake on a tray for 8 to 10 minutes until melted and bubbling.

name: Pizza toast
steps: Heat the grill to high and toast the bread on one side.
Spread the other side with tomato puree and add the ham.
Top with mozzarella and oregano.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until melted and golden.

name: Mild chicken curry for kids
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and chicken.
Stir in the curry paste and tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the apple and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the pack and serve with the curry.

name: Chicken and rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large pan, then remove.
Soften the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and paprika, return the chicken and add the stock.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve.

name: Cheese and ham pinwheels
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a baking tray.
Unroll the pastry and spread with the tomato puree.
Scatter over the ham and cheddar, then roll up tightly from the long side.
Slice into 12 rounds, place on the tray and brush with egg.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until golden and puffed.

name: Chicken dippers
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and oil a baking tray.
Dip the chicken strips in the flour, then the egg, then the cornflakes mixed with the paprika.
Lay on the tray and drizzle with the oil.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through.
Serve with ketchup for dipping.

name: Potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the wedges in the oil, paprika, garlic powder and seasoning.
Spread on a large tray in one layer.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.

name: Sweet potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the sweet potatoes in the oil, paprika, cumin and seasoning.
Spread on a large tray in one layer.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until soft and caramelised at the edges.

name: Cheesy beans on toast
steps: Heat the beans in a pan until bubbling.
Toast and butter the bread.
Spoon the beans over the toast and scatter with cheddar.
Grill for a minute until the cheese melts.

name: Scrambled egg wraps
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk.
Melt the butter in a pan and scramble the eggs gently until just set.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill with the eggs, cheddar and tomato and roll up.

name: Pasta bake for kids
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the pack says.
Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix the sauce with the drained pasta in an ovenproof dish.
Top with mozzarella and cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Meatballs for kids
steps: Mix the mince, half the onion, egg and breadcrumbs and shape into 20 small balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining onion, tomatoes and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti according to the pack and serve topped with the meatballs and sauce.

name: Turkey burgers
steps: Mix the mince, onion, herbs and egg and shape into four patties.
Heat the oil in a frying pan.
Fry the burgers for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through with no pink.
Serve in the buns with lettuce and tomato.

name: Mini burgers
steps: Mix the mince with the Worcestershire sauce and seasoning and shape into 12 small patties.
Heat the oil in a frying pan.
Fry the patties for 3 to 4 minutes each side until cooked through, adding cheddar for the last minute.
Serve in the buns with ketchup.

name: Cheesy mash
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
Drain well and return to the pan.
Mash with the butter and milk until smooth.
Stir in the cheddar and season.

name: Chicken goujons
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and oil a baking tray.
Dip the chicken in flour, then egg, then panko mixed with the parmesan.
Lay on the tray and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Veggie fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and oil a baking tray.
Squeeze the water out of the courgette and mix with the carrots, cheddar, half the breadcrumbs, eggs, flour and herbs.
Shape into 12 fingers and roll in the remaining breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and firm.

name: Omelette fingers
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, cheddar, sweetcorn and seasoning.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and pour in the mix.
Cook on a low heat for 5 minutes until set, flipping to brown the top.
Cool slightly and cut into fingers.

name: Tuna pasta
ingredients: 2 x 145g tins tuna in water, drained
steps: Cook the fusilli according to the pack and drain.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the tuna and sweetcorn and heat through.
Mix with the pasta and top with cheddar.

name: Popcorn chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken breast, cut into small chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and oil a baking tray.
Dip the chicken pieces in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumbs mixed with the garlic powder, paprika and seasoning.
Spread on the tray and drizzle with the oil.
Bake for 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the fajita seasoning.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked.
Add the peppers and onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Squeeze over the lime juice.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the filling, soured cream and cheddar.

name: Quesadillas
steps: Scatter the cheddar, pepper, spring onions and sweetcorn over two tortillas.
Top each with another tortilla and press down.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook each quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Chicken burgers
steps: Mix the mince, onion, herbs, egg and breadcrumbs and shape into four patties.
Heat the oil in a frying pan.
Fry the burgers for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Serve in the buns with lettuce and mayonnaise.

name: Beef burgers
steps: Mix the mince, onion, Worcestershire sauce and seasoning and shape into four patties.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat.
Fry the burgers for 4 to 5 minutes each side, adding cheddar for the last minute.
Toast the buns and serve with tomato and lettuce.

name: Hot dogs
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes until golden.
Heat the frankfurters in simmering water for 5 minutes.
Warm the rolls and fill with the sausages and onions.
Add ketchup and mustard.

name: Loaded fries
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and bake the fries for 20 to 25 minutes.
Grill the bacon until crisp, then chop.
Scatter the cheddar and bacon over the fries and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Top with spring onions, soured cream and paprika.

name: Chicken wraps
steps: Toss the chicken with the paprika.
Fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas and spread with mayonnaise.
Fill with lettuce, tomato and chicken, then roll up.

name: Halloumi wraps
steps: Fry the halloumi in the oil for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Warm the tortillas and spread with hummus.
Add the pepper, cucumber, rocket and halloumi.
Roll up and cut in half.

name: Prawn tacos
steps: Toss the prawns with the paprika and cumin.
Fry in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Warm the taco shells according to the pack.
Fill with prawns, avocado, soured cream and coriander and serve with lime.

name: Cheese and tomato tart
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and place the pastry on a baking tray.
Score a border 2cm in and brush with egg.
Spread the tomato puree inside the border and top with mozzarella and tomatoes.
Sprinkle with oregano, drizzle with oil and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

name: Tortilla pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and place the tortillas on baking trays.
Spread with tomato puree and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling.

name: Chicken and chorizo rice
steps: Fry the chicken and chorizo in the oil in a large pan for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and paprika, then pour in the stock.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

name: Speedy chilli
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the mince and brown for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chilli powder and cumin.
Add the tomatoes, beans, crumbled stock cube and 100ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the pack and serve with the chilli.

name: Garlic chicken
steps: Season the chicken and fry in the oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Add the butter and garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Squeeze in the lemon juice and spoon the sauce over the chicken.
Scatter with parsley.

name: Honey mustard chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and roast the potatoes with a little oil for 10 minutes.
Mix the honey, mustard, oil and garlic and coat the chicken.
Add the chicken to the tray and roast for 25 minutes until cooked through and glazed.
Serve with the potatoes.

name: Pesto salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and place the salmon on a lined tray.
Spread each fillet with pesto and press on the breadcrumbs.
Add the tomatoes and drizzle with the oil.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked and the crumbs are golden.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Baked salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Place the salmon on a sheet of foil, drizzle with oil and season.
Top with lemon slices and dill and fold the foil into a parcel.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Boil the green beans for 4 minutes and serve alongside.

name: Lamb kofta wraps
steps: Mix the lamb, onion, garlic, cumin and coriander and shape into 12 sausage shapes.
Fry in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with the kofta, cucumber and minted yoghurt.

name: Egg mayonnaise sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise, chives and seasoning.
Butter the bread and spread the egg mix over two slices.
Top with the remaining slices and cut in half.

name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and bake the bread cubes with a little oil for 8 minutes to make croutons.
Season the chicken and fry in the oil for 6 to 7 minutes each side, then slice.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing.
Top with chicken, croutons and parmesan.

name: Chicken stroganoff
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and paprika and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the soured cream and heat through.
Serve with rice cooked according to the pack.

name: Pork chops with apple
steps: Season the chops and fry in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through, then rest on a plate.
Add the butter and apple to the pan and fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in the mustard and cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the chops.

name: Lamb chops with mint
steps: Rub the chops with the oil, garlic, mint, salt and pepper.
Heat a frying pan until hot and fry the chops for 3 to 4 minutes each side for pink.
Rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with mint sauce.

name: Steak and chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and roast the chips in 2 tablespoons of the oil for 30 minutes, turning once.
Season the steaks and fry in the remaining oil over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium rare.
Add the butter and garlic and baste the steaks for 1 minute, then rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with the chips and watercress.

name: Falafel wraps
steps: Heat the falafel in the oven at 200C for 10 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and spread with hummus.
Add the cucumber, tomatoes, rocket and falafel.
Drizzle with yoghurt and roll up.

name: Chicken tikka wraps
steps: Mix the chicken with the tikka paste and 1 tablespoon of the yoghurt.
Fry in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the naan breads.
Fill with chicken, cucumber, red onion and coriander and drizzle with the remaining yoghurt.

name: Cajun chicken
steps: Rub the chicken with the Cajun seasoning and 1 tablespoon of the oil.
Fry for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through, then rest.
Fry the pepper and onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the pack.
Slice the chicken and serve with the vegetables and rice.

name: Chicken satay noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the pack and drain.
Fry the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the pepper for 3 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice and coconut milk together and pour into the pan.
Simmer for 3 minutes, then toss through the noodles.

name: Lemon and herb chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil on a tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the juice of 1 lemon with the garlic, herbs and remaining oil and coat the chicken.
Add the chicken and the other lemon cut into wedges to the tray and roast for 25 minutes.
Add the green beans for the last 10 minutes.

name: Garlic prawns
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with the crusty bread to mop up the juices.

name: Pan-fried cod with lemon butter
steps: Season the cod and heat the oil in a frying pan.
Fry skin side down for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan and spoon over the fish.
Scatter with parsley.

name: Fish pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with a little butter and milk. Preheat the oven to 200C.
Poach the fish in the milk with the bay leaf for 4 minutes, then lift out and strain the milk into a jug.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for a minute. Gradually whisk in the warm milk until thick and smooth.
Stir in half the cheddar, the parsley, peas, prawns and flaked fish. Season well and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the mash and remaining cheddar. Bake for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Salmon en croute
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Wilt the spinach in a pan, squeeze dry and chop.
Mix the spinach with the cream cheese, garlic, lemon zest and seasoning.
Cut the pastry into four squares. Spread the filling in the centre of each and top with a salmon fillet.
Wrap the pastry over the salmon, seal the edges and turn seam side down on a lined tray. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is golden and the salmon is cooked through.

name: Baked salmon with lemon
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C and line a baking tray.
Place the salmon on the tray, drizzle with olive oil and scatter over the garlic. Season well.
Slice one lemon and lay the slices on top of the fish.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze over the juice of the second lemon and sprinkle with dill to serve.

name: Honey soy salmon
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and sesame oil in a bowl.
Add the salmon and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200C. Place the salmon on a lined tray and spoon over the marinade.
Bake for 12 minutes, basting once, until glossy and cooked through.
Scatter with spring onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice.

name: Salmon fishcakes
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain well and mash until smooth.
Poach the salmon in simmering water for 8 minutes, then flake into the mash with the spring onions, lemon zest, parsley and seasoning.
Shape into 8 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Coat each in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes on each side until golden and hot through.

name: Smoked haddock fishcakes
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash.
Poach the haddock in the milk with the bay leaf for 6 minutes. Lift out, remove the skin and flake the flesh.
Mix the fish into the mash with the parsley, mustard and pepper. Shape into 8 cakes and chill for 20 minutes.
Dip each cake in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden.

name: Baked cod with parmesan crust
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C and line a tray.
Mix the parmesan, breadcrumbs, lemon zest, garlic, parsley and olive oil.
Season the cod and place on the tray. Press the crumb mixture on top of each fillet.
Bake for 15 minutes until the crust is golden and the fish flakes easily.

name: Fish goujons
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C and put a baking tray in to heat.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the paprika and seasoning.
Coat the fish strips in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Place on the hot tray and bake for 12 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce.

name: Fish tacos
ingredients: 500g white fish fillets, cut into strips
steps: Toss the fish with the paprika, cumin, half the oil and seasoning.
Fry the fish in the remaining oil for 2 to 3 minutes each side until cooked and lightly golden.
Mix the cabbage with the juice of the lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with fish, cabbage, avocado, soured cream and coriander.

name: Seared tuna steak
steps: Rub the tuna with half the oil and season well.
Heat a frying pan until very hot and sear the tuna for 2 minutes each side for pink in the middle.
Mix the tomatoes, capers, olives, remaining oil, lemon juice and basil to make a salsa.
Rest the tuna for 2 minutes, slice and serve with the salsa.

name: Prawn and chorizo
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil in a large pan for 3 minutes until the oil turns red.
Add the garlic and paprika and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Mussels in white wine
steps: Discard any open mussels that do not close when tapped, and pull off the beards.
Melt the butter in a large pan and soften the shallots and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the wine and bring to the boil, then tip in the mussels and cover.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, shaking the pan, until the shells open. Discard any that stay closed.
Stir in the cream and parsley and serve with bread.

name: Moules frites
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C. Toss the chips in the oil and salt and roast on a tray for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Meanwhile discard any open mussels and pull off the beards.
Soften the shallots and garlic in the butter in a large pan for 3 minutes.
Add the wine, bring to the boil, tip in the mussels and cover. Cook for 5 minutes until the shells open.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the chips.

name: Grilled mackerel
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and heat the grill to high.
Slash the mackerel skin a few times, rub with oil, coriander, salt and pepper.
Grill skin side up for 5 to 6 minutes until the skin is blistered and the flesh is cooked.
Squeeze over lemon juice, scatter with parsley and serve with the potatoes.

name: Trout with almonds
steps: Season the flour and dust the trout fillets.
Melt half the butter in a frying pan and fry the trout skin side down for 4 minutes, then turn for 2 minutes. Keep warm.
Wipe the pan, add the remaining butter and toast the almonds until golden.
Add the lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the trout.

name: Sea bass with fennel
steps: Soften the fennel in half the oil in a pan for 8 minutes. Add the fennel seeds and wine and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season the sea bass and score the skin.
Fry in the remaining oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.
Spoon the fennel onto plates, top with the fish and finish with lemon juice and dill.

name: Haddock mornay
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Poach the haddock in the milk with the bay leaf for 5 minutes, then lift out into a baking dish and flake lightly.
Strain the milk. Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk until thick.
Off the heat stir in 100g of the cheddar and the mustard and season.
Pour the sauce over the fish, then top with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Fish stew
ingredients: 500g mixed white fish, cut into chunks
steps: Soften the onion and fennel in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock and saffron and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the white fish and simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Season, stir through the parsley and serve with crusty bread.

name: Thai fish cakes
steps: Blitz the fish with the curry paste, egg and lime zest into a coarse paste.
Stir in the green beans and coriander.
With wet hands shape into 12 small patties.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Crab cakes
steps: Mix the crab with the spring onions, egg, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon zest and half the breadcrumbs. Season.
Shape into 8 small cakes and press into the remaining breadcrumbs.
Chill for 20 minutes to firm up.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and a green salad.

name: Fish finger pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with half the butter and 50ml milk. Preheat the oven to 200C.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the 400ml milk to make a white sauce. Stir in half the cheddar.
Cook the fish fingers according to the packet, then arrange in a baking dish with the peas.
Pour over the sauce and top with the mash and remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Lemon sole
steps: Season the flour and dust the fish.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a large frying pan and fry the sole for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.
Lift onto plates. Add the remaining butter, the capers and lemon juice to the pan and bubble for a minute.
Stir in the parsley and pour over the fish.

name: Plaice with brown butter
steps: Season the flour and dust the plaice.
Melt a third of the butter in a frying pan and fry the fillets for 2 minutes per side. Transfer to warm plates.
Add the remaining butter to the pan and cook until it foams and smells nutty and golden brown.
Add the lemon juice, capers and parsley and pour over the fish.

name: Fish en papillote
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C and cut two large squares of baking paper.
Divide the vegetables between the squares and set a fillet on each.
Top with lemon slices, thyme, oil, wine and seasoning.
Fold and crimp the paper edges to seal into parcels and place on a tray.
Bake for 15 minutes, then open at the table.

name: Salmon traybake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes in 2 tbsp oil and roast on a large tray for 20 minutes.
Add the broccoli and tomatoes to the tray and nestle in the salmon.
Mix the remaining oil with the garlic and the juice of half the lemon and drizzle over the salmon. Season.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.
Serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

name: Prawn skewers
steps: Soak the skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Mix the oil, garlic, paprika, chilli, lemon juice and parsley and toss with the prawns. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the prawns onto the skewers.
Grill or griddle for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and lightly charred.
Serve with extra lemon wedges.

name: Salmon with hollandaise
steps: Melt the butter and keep it warm. Whisk the egg yolks with the vinegar in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water until thick.
Slowly whisk in the melted butter until the sauce is glossy, then add the lemon juice and season.
Season the salmon and fry in the oil, skin side down, for 5 minutes, then turn for 2 minutes.
Steam the asparagus for 4 minutes.
Serve the salmon with the asparagus and hollandaise spooned over.

name: Grilled sardines
steps: Heat the grill to high.
Rub the sardines with the oil, garlic and salt.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side until the skin is crisp and charred in places.
Squeeze over lemon and scatter with parsley to serve.

name: Salt and pepper squid
steps: Pat the squid dry and mix the cornflour with the salt, pepper and five spice.
Toss the squid in the seasoned cornflour, shaking off the excess.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C and fry the squid in batches for 90 seconds until crisp. Drain on kitchen paper.
Fry the chilli and spring onions for 30 seconds and scatter over the squid.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Salmon burgers
steps: Chop the salmon finely or pulse briefly in a food processor.
Mix with the lemon zest, spring onions, capers, egg and breadcrumbs and season.
Shape into 4 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve in the buns with rocket and mayonnaise.

name: Potted shrimps
steps: Melt the butter gently and skim off the foam, keeping the clear butter.
Stir in the mace, cayenne, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Fold in the shrimps and warm for 1 minute.
Divide between 4 ramekins and chill for 2 hours until set. Serve with hot toast.

name: Baked sea bream
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Arrange the potato slices in a roasting tin, drizzle with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Slash the fish three times on each side and stuff with lemon, thyme and garlic.
Lay the fish on the potatoes, drizzle with the remaining oil and wine and season.
Roast for 20 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes away from the bone.

name: Cod and chorizo traybake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes, pepper and olive oil with the paprika on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the chorizo and tomatoes and roast for 10 minutes.
Season the cod, nestle it among the vegetables and roast for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Scatter with parsley to serve.

name: Moussaka
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Brush the aubergine slices with 3 tbsp oil and roast on trays for 25 minutes until golden.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the lamb and garlic and brown well.
Stir in the tomatoes, cinnamon and oregano and simmer for 20 minutes. Season.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk until thick. Off the heat beat in the egg and half the parmesan.
Layer the aubergines and lamb sauce in a baking dish, finishing with the white sauce and remaining parmesan.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling, then rest for 10 minutes.

name: Souvlaki
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and seasoning and toss through the chicken. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Soak the skewers in water, then thread on the chicken.
Grill or griddle for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm the pittas and fill with chicken, onion, tomato and tzatziki.

name: Lamb kleftiko
steps: Preheat the oven to 160C. Stab the lamb all over and push in slivers of garlic.
Rub with olive oil, oregano, salt, pepper and the juice of 1 lemon.
Place the potatoes in a deep roasting tin with the bay leaf and wine and set the lamb on top.
Cover tightly with foil and cook for 3 hours 30 minutes until the lamb falls apart.
Uncover, scatter over the feta and cook for 20 minutes more. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Spanakopita
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C. Wilt the spinach in a large pan, squeeze out all the water and chop.
Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes and mix with the spinach, feta, ricotta, eggs, dill, nutmeg and pepper.
Brush a baking dish with butter and layer in half the filo, brushing each sheet.
Spread over the filling and cover with the remaining filo, brushing between sheets. Score the top.
Bake for 40 minutes until deep golden and crisp.

name: Tzatziki
steps: Grate the cucumber, sprinkle with salt and leave for 10 minutes.
Squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, oil, mint and lemon juice.
Season and chill until ready to serve.

name: Gyros wraps
steps: Toss the pork with the oil, oregano, paprika, garlic and seasoning.
Fry in a hot pan in batches for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Warm the flatbreads.
Spread with tzatziki and fill with the pork, onion, tomato and parsley. Roll up.

name: Stifado
steps: Preheat the oven to 160C. Brown the beef in the oil in batches in a casserole dish.
Add the shallots and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree, then the tomatoes, wine, vinegar, cinnamon and bay leaves. Season.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours until the beef is very tender.
Remove the cinnamon and bay and serve with rice or crusty bread.

name: Pastitsio
steps: Preheat the oven to 180C. Cook the macaroni until just tender and drain.
Brown the mince with the onion and garlic. Add the tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer for 20 minutes.
Make a white sauce by melting the butter, stirring in the flour and whisking in the milk. Cool slightly then beat in the egg and half the parmesan.
Spread half the pasta in a dish, top with the meat sauce, then the remaining pasta.
Pour over the white sauce, scatter with the remaining parmesan and bake for 35 minutes until golden.

name: Halloumi fries
steps: Cut the halloumi into chunky chips and pat dry.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the paprika.
Coat the halloumi in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil in batches for 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Grilled halloumi with peppers
steps: Fry the peppers and onion in half the oil for 10 minutes until soft and lightly charred. Add the oregano.
Heat a griddle or frying pan with the remaining oil.
Cook the halloumi for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve over the peppers with lemon juice, mint and warm pitta.

name: Greek chicken traybake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Put the chicken, potatoes, onions and pepper in a large roasting tin.
Mix the oil, juice of 1 lemon, garlic, oregano and seasoning and toss through everything.
Roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Scatter over the feta and olives, roast for 5 minutes more and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Greek lemon potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Put the potatoes in a roasting tin.
Mix the oil, juice of 2 lemons, garlic, oregano and seasoning and pour over, then add the stock.
Roast for 60 minutes, turning twice, until tender, golden and the liquid is mostly absorbed.

name: Keftedes
steps: Mix the mince with the onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano and seasoning.
Shape into 20 small balls.
Fry in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with tzatziki and warm pitta.

name: Gigantes plaki
steps: Preheat the oven to 180C. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, puree, oregano and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes. Season.
Stir in the beans and tip into a baking dish.
Bake for 40 minutes until bubbling and thickened.
Top with dill and feta.

name: Avgolemono
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer, add the chicken and poach for 15 minutes. Lift out and shred.
Add the rice to the stock and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice, then slowly whisk in a ladle of hot stock.
Take the soup off the heat and stir in the egg mixture with the chicken. Do not boil.
Season and serve with dill.

name: Gemista
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C. Cut the tops off the peppers and tomatoes and scoop out the insides. Chop the tomato flesh.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the rice, tomato flesh, herbs and seasoning.
Fill the vegetables with the rice mixture and replace the tops.
Stand in a baking dish, drizzle with the remaining oil and add 100ml water to the dish.
Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes, uncovering for the final 15.

name: Briam
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C. Layer the courgettes, aubergine, potatoes and onion in a large baking dish.
Mix the tomatoes, oil, garlic, oregano and seasoning and pour over.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more until tender and caramelised. Scatter with parsley.

name: Paella
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and soften the onion and pepper for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika.
Stir in the rice and saffron, then pour in the hot stock. Season, bring to a simmer and do not stir again.
Cook for 12 minutes, then scatter over the prawns, mussels and peas.
Cook for 8 more minutes until the rice is tender and the mussels have opened. Discard any that stay shut.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Chicken and chorizo paella
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, chopped
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in the oil in a wide pan for 8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika.
Stir in the rice, return the meat and pour in the hot stock. Season and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 20 minutes without stirring, adding the peas for the last 5 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Rest for 5 minutes and sprinkle with parsley.

name: Patatas bravas
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in 3 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
For the sauce, soften the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, paprika and chilli.
Add the tomatoes and vinegar, simmer for 15 minutes and blend until smooth.
Pile the potatoes into a dish and spoon over the sauce.

name: Gambas pil pil
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan with the garlic and chillies over a low heat for 2 minutes without browning.
Turn up the heat, add the prawns and paprika and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Season and squeeze over lemon juice.
Scatter with parsley and serve sizzling with bread for the oil.

name: Albondigas
steps: Mix both minces with half the onion, half the garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, parsley and seasoning. Roll into 20 balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil, then remove.
Soften the remaining onion and garlic in the pan, add the paprika and wine and bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and return the meatballs. Simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with bread and parsley.

name: Chorizo and butter bean stew
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and the oil is red.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
Pour in the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season and top with parsley.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Soak the bread in a little water for 5 minutes.
Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, garlic and bread until smooth.
With the blender running add the oil and vinegar. Season to taste.
Chill for at least 2 hours and serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Pisto
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the courgettes and peppers and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and paprika, then the tomatoes. Season and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Chicken with chorizo and peppers
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Put the chicken, potatoes, peppers and onion in a large roasting tin.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic and seasoning.
Roast for 25 minutes, then add the chorizo.
Roast for 20 minutes more until the chicken is cooked through and golden. Scatter with parsley.

name: Garlic mushrooms
steps: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 1 minute.
Splash in the sherry and bubble until almost gone.
Season and stir in the parsley. Serve with bread.

name: Pan con tomate
steps: Toast or grill the ciabatta slices until golden.
Rub each slice with a cut garlic clove.
Halve the tomatoes and grate the flesh into a bowl, discarding the skins.
Spoon the tomato over the toast, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt.

name: Pollo al ajillo
steps: Season the chicken and brown skin side down in the oil in a large pan for 8 minutes. Turn and brown the other side.
Add the garlic cloves and fry for 2 minutes.
Pour in the sherry and stock and add the bay and paprika.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until cooked through, then uncover to reduce the sauce.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Spanish chickpea and spinach stew
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, paprika and cumin.
Pour in the tomatoes and chickpeas with 100ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and add the vinegar.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

name: Chorizo in red wine
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the wine, add the bay leaf and simmer for 10 minutes until the liquid is syrupy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Padron peppers
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat.
Add the peppers and fry for 4 to 5 minutes, turning, until blistered and softened.
Tip onto a plate, sprinkle with sea salt and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Hummus
steps: Put the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt in a food processor.
Blend, adding the cold water and 3 tbsp olive oil, until very smooth and creamy.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with paprika.

name: Falafel
steps: Pat the chickpeas dry. Blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs and spices until coarse but holding together.
Stir in the flour and bicarbonate of soda and chill for 20 minutes.
Shape into 16 small patties.
Shallow fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp.

name: Baba ganoush
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C. Prick the aubergines and roast on a tray for 40 minutes until collapsed and charred.
Cool slightly, then scoop out the flesh and drain in a sieve for 5 minutes.
Mash with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and scatter with parsley.

name: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 large bunches fresh parsley, finely chopped
steps: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes, then drain well and squeeze dry.
Mix with the parsley, mint, tomatoes and spring onions.
Dress with the lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Leave for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Fattoush
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Tear the pittas into pieces, toss in 1 tbsp oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp.
Combine the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, spring onions and mint in a bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, remaining oil, sumac and seasoning and toss through the salad.
Scatter over the pitta crisps just before serving.

name: Chicken shawarma
steps: Mix the oil, spices, garlic, lemon juice and a good pinch of salt and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
