Preheat the oven to 220C. Roast the chicken on a tray for 25 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Slice the chicken and warm the flatbreads.
Fill with chicken, red onion and yoghurt.

name: Lamb kofta
steps: Mix the mince, onion, garlic, spices, parsley and plenty of salt with your hands until sticky.
Divide into 8 and mould around the soaked skewers into sausage shapes. Chill for 15 minutes.
Grill or griddle for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve in warm flatbreads with yoghurt and salad.

name: Beef kofta
steps: Combine the mince, onion, garlic, spices, coriander and salt and mix well.
Shape into 12 oval patties or long finger shapes.
Fry in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve in warm pittas with hummus and salad.

name: Chicken tagine
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large casserole for 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onions for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken, add the stock and lemon and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 40 minutes, adding the olives for the last 10 minutes.
Scatter with coriander and serve with couscous.

name: Lamb tagine
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches in a casserole. Set aside.
Soften the onions for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer on a low heat for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the apricots and chickpeas and cook for 20 minutes more.
Season and stir through the coriander. Serve with couscous.

name: Vegetable tagine
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the squash, carrots, tomatoes, chickpeas, stock and apricots.
Cover and simmer for 35 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season and sprinkle with coriander. Serve with couscous.

name: Couscous with roasted veg
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Toss the vegetables in 2 tbsp oil and seasoning and roast for 30 minutes.
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the hot stock, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the lemon juice, remaining oil and mint.
Fold through the roasted vegetables and top with feta.

name: Harissa chicken
steps: Mix the harissa, yoghurt, 1 tbsp oil and lemon juice and coat the chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes if you have time.
Preheat the oven to 200C. Toss the onions, pepper and potatoes in the remaining oil on a large tray.
Nestle the chicken among the vegetables.
Roast for 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and charred. Scatter with coriander.

name: Persian jewelled rice
steps: Rinse the rice, boil for 6 minutes in salted water and drain.
Fry the onion in half the butter until deep golden, adding the cinnamon.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan, then mix with the apricots, pistachios, cranberries and orange zest.
Melt the remaining butter in a pan, layer in the rice, onion and fruit and nut mix, and dot with saffron steeped in 2 tbsp hot water.
Cover with a tea towel and lid and steam on the lowest heat for 25 minutes.

name: Lamb and apricot stew
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches in a large casserole.
Soften the onions for 8 minutes, add the garlic and spices.
Return the lamb, add the honey and stock, then cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the apricots and cook for 20 minutes more until the sauce is thick.
Top with toasted almonds and coriander and serve with rice or couscous.

name: Turkish eggs
steps: Mix the yoghurt with the garlic and a pinch of salt and divide between two shallow bowls.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter until foaming and stir in the chilli and paprika.
Place the eggs on the yoghurt, spoon over the spiced butter and top with dill. Serve with toast.

name: Turkish pide
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, warm water and 1 tbsp oil into a dough. Knead for 8 minutes, then leave to rise for 1 hour.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil, add the lamb and brown. Stir in the tomato puree and spices and cook for 10 minutes. Cool and add the parsley.
Preheat the oven to 230C. Divide the dough into 4 and roll each into a long oval.
Spoon the filling down the middle, leaving a border, and pinch the ends into a boat shape.
Bake on hot trays for 12 to 15 minutes until golden.

name: Lahmacun
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water into a dough, knead for 8 minutes and leave to rise for 45 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 240C with trays inside.
Mix the lamb, onion, puree, pepper, garlic, paprika and half the parsley.
Divide the dough into 4 and roll very thin. Spread the topping to the edges.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Top with parsley and lemon and roll up to eat.

name: Chicken shish kebabs
steps: Mix the yoghurt, oil, garlic, puree, spices and lemon juice and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Thread the chicken onto soaked skewers with the pepper and onion.
Grill or barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with rice, salad and flatbreads.

name: Lamb shish kebabs
steps: Mix the oil, onion, garlic, spices and lemon juice and coat the lamb. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Thread onto soaked skewers with the peppers.
Grill or barbecue for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred outside and still juicy.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with flatbreads and salad.

name: Doner kebab
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Blend the mince, grated onion, garlic, spices and salt in a food processor until a smooth paste forms.
Press into a loaf tin and bake for 40 minutes until cooked through. Rest for 10 minutes.
Slice very thinly and crisp up the slices in a hot dry frying pan for 2 minutes.
Fill warm pittas with lamb, lettuce, tomato, onion, garlic mayonnaise and chilli sauce.

name: Pitta with halloumi
steps: Fry the halloumi in the oil for 1 to 2 minutes each side until golden.
Warm the pittas and split them open.
Spread with hummus and fill with rocket, tomato, cucumber and halloumi.
Drizzle with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Mujadara
steps: Fry the onions in the oil over a medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and crisp. Set half aside.
In a pan, simmer the lentils in the stock for 15 minutes.
Add the rice, cumin, cinnamon and half the onions, cover and cook gently for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes, then top with the reserved onions and serve with yoghurt.

name: Ful medames
steps: Warm the beans in a pan with a splash of water for 8 minutes, then lightly mash some of them.
Stir in 1 tbsp oil, the garlic, cumin and lemon juice and season.
Spoon into bowls and top with the tomatoes, parsley and halved eggs.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and serve with warm pitta.

name: Harira
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas and stock.
Simmer for 35 minutes until the lentils are soft and the soup is thick.
Stir in the coriander, season and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Imam bayildi
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C. Slit each aubergine lengthways without cutting through and fry in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, turning, until lightly browned.
Soften the onions in the remaining oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, sugar and parsley and simmer for 10 minutes.
Place the aubergines in a baking dish and stuff the slits with the filling.
Add the lemon juice and 100ml water to the dish, cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Roasted cauliflower with tahini
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C. Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin, paprika and salt and roast for 30 minutes until charred.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 3 to 4 tbsp cold water into a pourable sauce.
Pile the cauliflower on a plate, drizzle with tahini and scatter with parsley and pomegranate seeds.

name: Za'atar roast chicken
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Mix the za'atar with the oil and rub all over the chicken.
Put the lemon halves and garlic in the cavity and set the chicken in a roasting tin.
Arrange the onions and potatoes around it and season.
Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until the juices run clear, basting once.
Rest for 15 minutes, then carve and scatter with parsley.

name: Coq au vin
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a casserole dish, then set aside. Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside with the chicken.
Fry the shallots and mushrooms in the same pot until golden. Add the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, then pour in the wine and stock, scraping up the bits from the base.
Return the chicken and bacon, add the thyme and bay and simmer gently, covered, for 50 minutes.
Uncover and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken. Season and serve with mash.

name: Chicken provencal
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes on each side, then remove.
Soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes, add the garlic and herbs.
Pour in the wine and bubble for 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 30 minutes, adding the olives for the last 5.
Season and scatter with basil.

name: Tartiflette
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C. Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender and drain.
Fry the lardons until crisp, add the onion and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and wine and bubble for 2 minutes.
Mix with the potatoes and cream and tip into a baking dish.
Slice the cheese in half horizontally and lay rind side up on top.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Croque madame
steps: Melt 25g butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk to make a thick white sauce. Stir in half the gruyere, the nutmeg and seasoning.
Butter the bread, spread with mustard and make two sandwiches with ham and a little cheese.
Top with the sauce and remaining cheese and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Fry the eggs in a little butter and put one on each sandwich.

name: Steak frites
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C. Toss the chips in 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Bring the steaks to room temperature, pat dry and season well.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan until smoking and cook the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium rare.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste the steaks for 1 minute. Rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with the chips and rocket.

name: Peppercorn sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan and soften the shallots for 3 minutes.
Add the peppercorns and brandy and let it bubble away.
Add the stock and simmer for 5 minutes until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Season and serve with steak.

name: Gratin dauphinois
ingredients: 1kg waxy potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
steps: Preheat the oven to 160C and butter a baking dish.
Heat the cream, milk, garlic, nutmeg and seasoning in a pan until just simmering.
Layer the potatoes in the dish, pouring some of the creamy mix between each layer.
Pour over the rest, dot with the remaining butter and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender and golden.

name: Vegetable chilli
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion, carrot and pepper for 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the courgette, tomatoes, beans and stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 30 minutes until thick, stirring now and then.
Season well and serve with rice or baked potatoes.

name: Three bean chilli
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato puree and all three beans.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes, adding a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Season and serve with rice and soured cream.

name: Lentil shepherd's pie
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then mash with the butter and milk.
Fry the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 10 minutes, then add the garlic.
Stir in the lentils, tomatoes, tomato puree and stock and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Tip the lentils into an ovenproof dish and top with the mash, roughing it up with a fork.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Lentil bolognese
steps: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, tomato puree, oregano and stock.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the spaghetti according to the packet and drain.
Toss with the sauce and top with torn basil.

name: Nut roast
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and line a 900g loaf tin with baking paper.
Soften the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Mix the onion with the nuts, breadcrumbs, cheddar, eggs, thyme, tomato puree and stock, and season.
Press the mixture into the tin and cover with foil.
Bake for 35 minutes, remove the foil and bake for 15 minutes more until golden.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Mushroom Wellington
steps: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil over a high heat for 12 minutes until all the liquid has gone.
Add the garlic and thyme, then stir in the chestnuts and breadcrumbs. Season and cool.
Unroll the pastry on a floured surface and spoon the filling down the middle.
Fold the pastry over to enclose it, seal the edges and place seam-side down on a tray.
Brush with egg, score the top and bake at 200C for 35 minutes until deep golden.

name: Stuffed peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and place the pepper halves cut-side up in a baking dish.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix in the feta and parsley, then spoon into the peppers.
Bake for 30 minutes until the peppers are soft.

name: Stuffed mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and set the mushrooms gill-side up on a tray.
Chop the stalks and fry them in the oil with the garlic for 3 minutes.
Mix with the cream cheese, breadcrumbs, half the cheddar and the parsley.
Pile the filling into the mushrooms and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and tender.

name: Cauliflower steaks
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Trim the cauliflower and cut it into 2 or 3 thick slices through the centre.
Mix the oil, paprika, cumin, garlic and lemon juice and brush over both sides of the steaks.
Roast on a tray for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred and tender.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

name: Whole roasted cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and boil a kettle.
Simmer the whole cauliflower in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Mix the butter, garlic, spices, oil and lemon juice and rub all over the cauliflower.
Roast in a tin for 50 to 60 minutes, basting halfway, until deep golden and tender.
Cut into wedges to serve.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Fry the aubergine in 2 tbsp oil in a large pan until golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion, peppers and courgettes in the remaining oil for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, tomato puree, thyme and the aubergine.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season and stir through torn basil.

name: Veggie burgers
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes and let cool.
Mash the beans roughly and mix with the vegetables, breadcrumbs, cumin, tomato puree and egg.
Shape into 4 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in a little oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve in buns with lettuce and tomato.

name: Bean burgers
steps: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Mix in the onion, garlic, spices, breadcrumbs and flour, and season.
Shape into 4 patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve in buns topped with avocado.

name: Halloumi burgers
steps: Brush the halloumi slices with oil.
Fry or grill for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Toast the buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer with tomato, rocket and halloumi.
Drizzle with sweet chilli sauce and serve.

name: Mushroom burgers
steps: Stir the oil and garlic together and brush over the mushrooms.
Grill or fry for 5 minutes each side until tender.
Top with cheddar for the last minute so it melts.
Toast the buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Build with lettuce, tomato and the mushrooms.

name: Tofu scramble
steps: Drain the tofu and crumble it into a bowl.
Fry the spring onions in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric, cumin and nutritional yeast and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season well.

name: Scrambled tofu on toast
steps: Crumble the tofu into a bowl.
Fry the garlic and tomatoes in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric and soy sauce and cook for 5 minutes.
Toast the bread and pile the tofu on top.
Scatter with chives and black pepper.

name: Chickpea stew
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cook for 5 minutes until tender.
Finish with lemon juice and season.

name: Butter bean stew
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 1 minute.
Add the butter beans, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until thick and the carrots are tender.
Stir in the parsley and serve with crusty bread.

name: White bean and kale stew
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cook for 5 minutes until wilted.
Season and add the lemon juice.

name: Vegetable stew and dumplings
steps: Fry the onion, carrots and parsnips in the oil for 8 minutes, then stir in the plain flour.
Add the stock, potatoes and thyme, bring to the boil and simmer for 25 minutes.
Rub the butter into the self-raising flour, add the parsley and enough cold water to make a soft dough.
Roll into 8 balls and drop onto the stew.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes until the dumplings are fluffy.

name: Mushroom stroganoff
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the mushrooms and cook over a high heat for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika and tomato puree and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the soured cream and lemon juice and scatter with parsley. Serve over the rice.

name: Veggie sausage and mash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Cook the sausages in the oven or under the grill following the packet.
Fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the sausages on the mash with onion gravy.

name: Veggie toad in the hole
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and mustard into a smooth batter, season and rest for 10 minutes.
Put the sausages and oil in a roasting tin and heat in the oven for 10 minutes until the oil is smoking hot.
Pour in the batter quickly and return to the oven.
Bake for 30 minutes until risen and golden. Do not open the door early.

name: Veggie cottage pie
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes and mash with the butter and milk.
Fry the onion, carrots and mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the vegetarian mince, tomato puree, stock and soy sauce and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Spoon into a baking dish and top with mash.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Roast vegetable traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Tip all the vegetables and garlic into a large tray.
Drizzle with the oil, add the oregano and season.
Roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until soft and charred at the edges.

name: Veg and halloumi traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the vegetables with the oil and oregano on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the halloumi and roast for 15 minutes more until golden.
Drizzle with honey and scatter with mint.

name: Aubergine bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the aubergine with 2 tbsp oil and roast for 20 minutes.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil, add the garlic, tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the aubergine and sauce in a baking dish.
Top with the feta and bake for 20 minutes.
Scatter with parsley before serving.

name: Stuffed aubergine
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Score the aubergine flesh, brush with 2 tbsp oil and roast cut-side up for 30 minutes.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil, add the garlic and cumin, then the tomatoes and chickpeas.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Scoop out some aubergine flesh and stir it into the filling.
Spoon the filling into the shells and top with feta.
Bake for 15 minutes and scatter with parsley.

name: Courgette fritters
steps: Toss the courgettes with the salt and leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Mix with the flour, eggs, spring onions, feta and baking powder.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and drop in spoonfuls of the batter.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve warm.

name: Vegetable fritters
steps: Squeeze the grated carrots, potato and onion in a tea towel to remove excess water.
Mix with the flour, eggs, cumin and coriander, and season.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry spoonfuls of mixture for 4 minutes each side.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve hot.

name: Cheese and potato pie
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes, drain and leave to steam dry.
Soften the onion in the butter, then mix with the potatoes, cheddar and milk. Season.
Line a pie dish with one pastry sheet and fill with the potato mixture.
Cover with the second sheet, seal, trim and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C for 35 minutes until golden.

name: Leek and potato gratin
steps: Heat the oven to 180C.
Soften the leeks in the butter for 5 minutes.
Warm the cream, milk and garlic together and season.
Layer the potatoes and leeks in a buttered dish, pouring over the cream mixture as you go.
Top with cheddar and bake for 50 minutes until golden and tender.

name: Potato dauphinoise
steps: Heat the oven to 160C and butter a baking dish.
Heat the cream, milk, garlic and nutmeg until just simmering and season generously.
Layer the potatoes in the dish, pouring over some of the cream between layers.
Pour over the rest and cover with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes, uncover and bake for 30 minutes more until golden and tender.

name: Cheese souffle
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and butter a 1.5 litre soufflé dish.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer until thick.
Off the heat, beat in the cheddar, egg yolks, mustard and nutmeg, and season.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into the sauce in two batches.
Pour into the dish and bake for 25 minutes until risen and golden. Serve at once.

name: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Wilt the spinach in a pan, squeeze dry and chop.
Mix with the ricotta, nutmeg and seasoning and pipe or spoon into the cannelloni tubes.
Fry the garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Spread over the base of a dish.
Lay the tubes on top, pour over the cream and sprinkle with parmesan.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover for 10 minutes until golden.

name: Spinach and feta pie
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Wilt the spinach in a pan, squeeze dry and chop.
Soften the onion in the oil and mix with the spinach, feta, ricotta, eggs and dill.
Layer half the filo in a greased dish, brushing each sheet with butter.
Add the filling and cover with the remaining filo, brushing with butter.
Bake for 35 minutes until crisp and golden.

name: Veg fajitas
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan until very hot.
Fry the peppers, onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes until charred at the edges.
Add the spices and lime juice and cook for 1 minute.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the vegetables.
Top with soured cream and coriander.

name: Black bean tacos
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the beans and a splash of water and cook for 8 minutes, lightly mashing some.
Warm the taco shells in the oven.
Fill with beans, avocado and cheddar.
Finish with coriander and lime juice.

name: Sweet potato and black bean chilli
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, beans and stock.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the lime juice and season.

name: Jackfruit tacos
steps: Squeeze the jackfruit dry and shred it with two forks.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, spices and jackfruit and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the barbecue sauce and 100ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with jackfruit and cabbage.
Top with coriander and lime juice.

name: Vegan bolognese
steps: Fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, soya mince, tomatoes, tomato puree, oregano and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until rich and thick.
Cook the spaghetti according to the packet and drain.
Serve the sauce over the pasta.

name: Vegan chilli
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the soya mince, tomatoes, beans and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Stir in the chocolate and season. Serve with rice.

name: Vegan shepherd's pie
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and mash with 2 tbsp oil and the oat milk.
Fry the onion and carrots in the remaining oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic and thyme.
Stir in the lentils, tomatoes and soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes, adding the peas at the end.
Spoon into a baking dish, top with mash and rough up with a fork.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Vegan mac and cheese
steps: Boil the potatoes, carrot, onion and cashews in water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain.
Blend with the garlic, nutritional yeast, mustard, lemon juice and oat milk until smooth.
Cook the macaroni according to the packet and drain.
Stir the sauce through the pasta and heat gently.
Season well and serve.

name: Vegan burgers
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly in a bowl.
Mix in the onion, garlic, oats, tomato puree and spices, and season.
Shape into 4 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 5 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve in the buns with your favourite toppings.

name: Vegan sausage rolls
steps: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes, adding the garlic at the end. Cool.
Mash the beans and mix with the vegetables, breadcrumbs, sage and soy sauce.
Cut the pastry sheets in half lengthways and spoon the filling along each strip.
Roll up, seal, cut into 4 pieces each and brush with oat milk.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Tofu katsu
steps: Press the tofu for 15 minutes, then slice each block into 2 steaks.
Whisk the plain flour with the oat milk to a batter, dip the tofu and coat in panko.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Soften the onion, stir in the curry powder and extra flour, then add the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the tofu sliced over rice with the sauce.

name: Tempeh stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Fry the tempeh in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, adding the garlic and ginger at the end.
Return the tempeh, add the soy sauce and honey and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Buddha bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the sweet potatoes and chickpeas in the oil and paprika and roast for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa according to the packet.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and 3 tbsp water.
Divide the quinoa, spinach, cabbage, roasted vegetables and avocado between two bowls.
Drizzle with the tahini dressing.

name: Grain bowl
steps: Cook the barley in boiling water for 25 minutes and drain.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 5 minutes, adding the kale for the last 2 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and halve.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil.
Pile the barley, vegetables and eggs into bowls, drizzle with dressing and scatter with sesame seeds.

name: Lentil salad
steps: Simmer the lentils in water for 20 to 25 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard together and season.
Toss the warm lentils with the dressing.
Fold in the onion, tomatoes, cucumber and parsley.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Quinoa and roasted veg
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil and the cumin on a tray.
Roast for 30 minutes until tender and browned.
Cook the quinoa in the stock for 15 minutes, then drain and fluff with a fork.
Mix with the roasted vegetables, remaining oil, lemon juice and parsley.

name: Stuffed squash
ingredients: 2 small butternut squash, halved and deseeded
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the squash with 1 tbsp oil, season and roast cut-side down for 35 minutes.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil, add the garlic and sage.
Mix with the rice, cranberries, pecans and half the goat's cheese.
Turn the squash over, fill with the mixture and top with the rest of the cheese.
Roast for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Veg kebabs
steps: Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 10 minutes.
Mix the oil, garlic, oregano and lemon juice and toss with the vegetables.
Thread the vegetables onto the skewers.
Grill or barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until charred and tender.

name: Halloumi kebabs
steps: Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 10 minutes.
Thread the halloumi and vegetables onto the skewers.
Brush with the oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Grill or barbecue for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and charred.
Scatter with mint to serve.

name: Mushroom pie
steps: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil over a high heat for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and flour, then pour in the stock and cream and simmer until thick.
Stir in the thyme, season and tip into a pie dish. Cool slightly.
Cover with the pastry, trim, crimp and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Cheese and onion pasties
steps: Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes and drain.
Soften the onions in the butter and cool, then mix with the potatoes and cheddar and season.
Roll out the pastry on a floured surface and cut 4 circles of about 18cm.
Spoon the filling into the centres, fold over, crimp the edges and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Vegetable pasties
steps: Boil the potato, carrot and swede for 8 minutes, drain and cool.
Mix with the onion, crumbled stock cube and seasoning.
Roll out the pastry on a floured surface and cut 4 circles of about 18cm.
Fill, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edges.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 35 minutes until golden.

name: Veggie Scotch eggs
steps: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mix the sausage meat with the mustard and divide into 4 portions.
Flatten each portion, wrap around an egg and seal.
Roll in flour, the beaten egg and then the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170C and fry for 6 minutes until golden, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

name: Pea and mint fritters
steps: Roughly crush half the peas with a fork.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs and milk into a batter and stir in all the peas, mint and feta.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry spoonfuls of batter for 3 minutes each side.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve warm.

name: Broccoli and cheese bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Boil the broccoli for 3 minutes and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in two thirds of the cheddar and the mustard and season.
Put the broccoli in a baking dish, pour over the sauce and top with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Leek and cheese bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Steam or boil the leeks for 5 minutes and drain well.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in two thirds of the cheddar and the mustard and season.
Place the leeks in a baking dish and pour over the sauce.
Top with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheddar and bake for 25 minutes.

name: Vegetable enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Fry the onion, pepper and courgette in the oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the beans and cumin and cook for 2 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes and chilli powder for 10 minutes to make a sauce.
Fill the tortillas with the vegetable mix and roll up into a dish.
Pour over the sauce, sprinkle with cheddar and bake for 20 minutes.

name: Bean quesadillas
steps: Mash the beans roughly with the cumin.
Spread over two tortillas and top with cheddar and spring onions.
Cover with the other two tortillas.
Fry each in a little oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with avocado.

name: Vegetable spring rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Stir-fry the carrots and cabbage in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beansprouts, spring onions, ginger and soy sauce, then cool.
Place a spoonful of filling on each wrapper, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Brush with oil and bake for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

name: Stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake for 45 minutes until soft.
Toss the chickpeas with the oil and paprika and roast alongside for the last 20 minutes.
Split the sweet potatoes and fluff the insides.
Top with chickpeas, feta, spring onions and a spoonful of yoghurt.

name: Vegetable frittata
steps: Heat the grill. Fry the onion, courgette and pepper in an ovenproof pan with the oil for 8 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the cheddar and parsley and season.
Pour over the vegetables and cook on a low heat for 6 minutes until almost set.
Grill for 3 minutes until golden on top.
Cut into wedges.

name: Root vegetable gratin
steps: Heat the oven to 180C.
Warm the cream, milk, garlic and thyme and season.
Layer the vegetables in a buttered dish, pouring over the cream as you go.
Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Uncover, top with cheddar and bake for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Tomato tart
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Place the pastry on a tray and score a 2cm border.
Brush the border with egg and spread the tomato puree inside.
Scatter with mozzarella and arrange the tomatoes on top.
Drizzle with oil, add the oregano and season.
Bake for 30 minutes until the pastry is risen and golden, then add basil.

name: Goat's cheese tart
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 23cm tart tin with the pastry and bake blind for 15 minutes.
Soften the onions in the oil for 10 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, cream and milk together and season.
Scatter the onions and cheese in the case and pour in the egg mixture.
Add the thyme and bake at 180C for 30 minutes until just set.

name: Caramelised onion tart
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onions slowly for 30 minutes until deep golden, adding the vinegar, sugar and thyme at the end.
Heat the oven to 200C and place the pastry on a tray. Score a 2cm border.
Brush the border with egg, spread the onions inside and top with gruyere.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Chips
steps: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, rinse in cold water and dry well.
Heat the oil to 140C in a deep pan and fry the chips in batches for 6 minutes until soft but not coloured. Drain.
Raise the oil to 190C and fry the chips again for 4 minutes until golden and crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with salt.

name: Oven chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and put a large tray inside to heat up.
Soak the chips in cold water for 10 minutes, then dry thoroughly.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and salt.
Spread on the hot tray and bake for 40 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.

name: Hasselback potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Cut thin slits across each potato, stopping before the base.
Mix the butter, oil, garlic and thyme and brush over the potatoes, getting it between the slices.
Roast for 50 minutes, basting halfway.
Sprinkle with parmesan and roast for 10 minutes more.

name: Boulangere potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and butter a baking dish.
Layer the potatoes and onions with the thyme, seasoning each layer.
Pour over the stock until it almost covers the top layer.
Dot with butter and bake for 75 minutes until tender and golden on top.

name: New potatoes with mint
steps: Put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water with the mint sprig.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Drain well and return to the pan.
Toss with the butter and chopped mint and season.

name: Buttered greens
steps: Boil the cabbage and kale in salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Melt the butter in the pan and add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Toss the greens through the butter and season.

name: Honey glazed carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the carrots with the oil and season on a tray.
Roast for 20 minutes, then drizzle with the honey and thyme.
Roast for 10 minutes more until sticky, then add the balsamic vinegar.

name: Carrot and swede mash
steps: Boil the swede and carrots in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender.
Drain well and leave to steam dry for 2 minutes.
Mash with the butter and nutmeg until smooth and season.

name: Roasted Brussels sprouts
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the sprouts with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast cut-side down for 25 minutes until crisp and caramelised.
Drizzle with the balsamic vinegar and serve.

name: Sprouts with bacon
steps: Boil the sprouts for 3 minutes and drain.
Fry the bacon in the oil until crisp.
Add the sprouts and garlic and fry for 5 minutes until browned.
Stir in the butter and season.

name: Creamed spinach
steps: Wilt the spinach in a large pan for 2 minutes, then squeeze out the water and chop.
Melt the butter and fry the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cream and nutmeg and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and season.

name: Green beans with almonds
steps: Boil the beans for 4 minutes and drain.
Melt the butter and toast the almonds for 2 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Toss in the beans and lemon juice and season.

name: Roasted broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic, chilli flakes and seasoning on a tray.
Roast for 15 to 18 minutes until the edges are charred.
Squeeze over the lemon juice.

name: Corn on the cob
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob, husks removed
steps: Boil the corn in unsalted water for 8 to 10 minutes until tender.
Drain and pat dry.
Mix the butter, paprika and lime juice.
Brush over the hot corn and sprinkle with salt.

name: Peas with mint
steps: Boil the peas for 3 minutes and drain.
Return to the pan with the butter and sugar.
Stir in the mint and season.

name: Roasted beetroot
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve or quarter the beetroot and toss in the oil, thyme and seasoning.
Roast covered in foil for 40 minutes, then uncover and roast for 15 minutes.
Drizzle with the balsamic vinegar before serving.

name: Parsnip crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice the parsnips very thinly with a peeler or mandoline.
Toss with the oil, salt and cumin and spread over 2 lined trays.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, turning once, until golden. They crisp as they cool.

name: Onion rings
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and paprika with the sparkling water to a thick batter.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pan.
Dip the onion rings in the batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden.
Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with salt.

name: Rice pilaf
steps: Heat the oil and butter and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stock and bay leaf, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in the parsley.

name: Lemon couscous
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl and pour over the hot stock.
Cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the oil, lemon zest and juice and parsley. Season.

name: Flatbreads
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the yoghurt, oil and enough water to make a soft dough.
Knead for 2 minutes and rest for 15 minutes.
Divide into 6 pieces and roll each into a thin round.
Cook in a dry hot frying pan for 2 minutes each side until puffed and spotted.

name: Sweet potato fries
ingredients: 800g sweet potatoes, cut into thin chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss the sweet potatoes with the cornflour, oil, paprika and salt.
Spread on two trays without crowding.
Bake for 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.

name: Roasted parsnips
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and put the oil in a roasting tin to heat.
Parboil the parsnips for 5 minutes and drain.
Toss in the hot oil and roast for 30 minutes.
Drizzle with honey, add the thyme and roast for 10 minutes more.

name: Roasted carrots with cumin
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the carrots with the oil, cumin seeds and seasoning on a tray.
Roast for 30 minutes until tender and charred.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Smashed potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender and drain.
Heat the oven to 220C and oil a large tray.
Place the potatoes on the tray and squash each one with a masher.
Drizzle with the oil, butter, garlic and rosemary and season.
Roast for 30 minutes until crisp and golden.

name: Chilli con carne
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mince and brown over a high heat, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in the tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and 150ml water.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes, then add the kidney beans and cook for 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice according to the packet and serve with the chilli.

name: Slow cooker chilli
steps: Brown the mince in a frying pan over a high heat and drain off any excess fat.
Tip the mince into the slow cooker with the onion, garlic and pepper.
Add the tomatoes, beans, tomato puree, spices and crumbled stock cube, then stir well.
Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours.
Season to taste and serve with rice or baked potatoes.

name: Beef bourguignon
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Toss the beef in the flour and brown in batches in the oil in a casserole dish, then set aside.
Fry the bacon, onion and carrots for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato puree and cook for 1 minute.
Return the beef to the dish and pour in the wine and stock. Add the thyme and bay leaf and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours.
Add the mushrooms and cook for a further 30 minutes until the beef is tender. Serve with mash.

name: Beef stroganoff
ingredients: 450g beef rump steak, sliced into strips
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and sear the steak in batches for 1 to 2 minutes. Set aside.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the remaining oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika and tomato puree.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 3 minutes, then return the steak to the pan.
Stir in the soured cream, heat gently and scatter over the parsley. Serve with the rice.

name: Beef goulash
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown the beef in the oil in a casserole dish in batches and set aside.
Soften the onions for 8 minutes, then stir in the garlic, paprika and caraway seeds.
Return the beef with the pepper, tomatoes, tomato puree and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours until tender.
Serve over cooked noodles with a spoonful of soured cream.

name: Beef casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Toss the beef in the flour and brown in the oil in batches in a casserole dish.
Soften the onions, carrots and celery in the same dish for 5 minutes.
Return the beef and add the stock, tomato puree, Worcestershire sauce and thyme.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours until the beef is tender.
Season well and serve with mash or crusty bread.

name: Slow cooker beef brisket
steps: Rub the brisket with the paprika, salt and pepper and sear on all sides in the oil in a hot frying pan.
Put the onions, garlic and carrots in the slow cooker and sit the brisket on top.
Mix the stock, tomato puree, Worcestershire sauce and sugar and pour over. Add the bay leaf.
Cook on low for 9 to 10 hours until the beef falls apart.
Rest the meat for 15 minutes, slice or shred, and serve with the juices.

name: Pot roast
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Season the beef and brown all over in the oil in a large casserole dish, then remove.
Add the onions and garlic to the dish and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree and stock.
Return the beef, add the thyme and bay leaf, cover and cook for 2 hours.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for a further 1 hour until tender.
Rest the beef for 10 minutes, then slice and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

name: Braised beef short ribs
steps: Heat the oven to 150C. Season the ribs and brown on all sides in the oil in a casserole dish. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrots for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and tomato puree.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble for 5 minutes, then add the stock, rosemary and bay leaf.
Return the ribs, cover and cook in the oven for 3 hours until the meat is falling off the bone.
Skim the fat, reduce the sauce on the hob if you wish and serve with mash.

name: Pulled pork
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder, cumin and salt and rub all over the pork.
Put the onions in the slow cooker, sit the pork on top and pour in the cola.
Cook on low for 9 to 10 hours until the meat shreds easily.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir in the barbecue sauce and some of the cooking juices.
Pile into the rolls and serve.

name: Pulled chicken
steps: Place the onion, garlic and chicken in the slow cooker.
Mix the barbecue sauce, vinegar, paprika, sugar and stock and pour over the chicken.
Cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 3 hours.
Shred the chicken with two forks and toss it in the sauce.
Pile into the rolls to serve.

name: Chicken and chorizo casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Fry the chorizo in a casserole dish until the oil runs, then remove.
Brown the chicken in the chorizo oil and set aside. Soften the onion and pepper in the dish.
Stir in the garlic and paprika, then add the tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and 100ml water.
Return the chicken and chorizo, cover and cook in the oven for 40 minutes.
Add the butter beans for the last 10 minutes and scatter with parsley to serve.

name: Chicken and mushroom casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 180C. Brown the chicken in the butter in a casserole dish and set aside.
Fry the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and flour.
Pour in the stock, add the mustard, thyme and potatoes and return the chicken.
Cover and cook in the oven for 40 minutes.
Stir in the cream and season to serve.

name: Sausage and bean casserole
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil in a large pan, then remove and slice into chunks.
Soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes, tomato puree, crumbled stock cube, thyme and 200ml water.
Return the sausages with the beans and simmer for 30 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

name: Pork casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown the pork in the oil in batches in a casserole dish and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrots, add the garlic and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Add the stock, mustard, tomato puree and sage and bring to a simmer.
Return the pork, cover and cook in the oven for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Season and serve with mash.

name: Lamb casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown the lamb in batches in the oil in a casserole dish and set aside.
Soften the onion, carrots and garlic for 5 minutes, then stir in the flour.
Add the stock, tomato puree and rosemary and return the lamb.
Cover and cook in the oven for 1 hour 30 minutes, adding the potatoes for the last 45 minutes.
Season and serve.

name: Lamb shanks
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown the shanks all over in the oil in a casserole dish and set aside.
Soften the onion, carrots and garlic for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree and wine and bubble for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock, rosemary and bay leaf and return the shanks.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours 30 minutes until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with mash and spoon over the sauce.

name: Slow cooker lamb
steps: Make small cuts in the lamb and push in the garlic and rosemary. Season well and brown in the oil in a hot pan.
Put the onions in the slow cooker with the stock and sit the lamb on top.
Cook on low for 8 to 9 hours until the lamb is very tender.
Lift out the lamb and rest. Whisk the flour and redcurrant jelly into the juices and simmer in a pan to make a gravy.
Pull the lamb apart and serve with the gravy.

name: Cassoulet
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown the duck legs skin-side down in a casserole dish, then remove. Brown the sausages and set aside.
Fry the bacon and onion in the duck fat, add the garlic and tomato puree.
Add the tomatoes, stock, thyme and beans and return the duck and sausages, cut into chunks.
Cover and cook for 2 hours, then scatter over the breadcrumbs.
Cook uncovered for 30 minutes until golden on top.

name: Jambalaya
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the chicken and chorizo for 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onion, pepper and celery in the same pan, then stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Add the rice, tomatoes and stock, return the chicken and chorizo and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the prawns and cook for 5 minutes until pink.

name: Gumbo
steps: Heat the oil and whisk in the flour. Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes until the roux is the colour of milk chocolate.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chorizo, Cajun seasoning, tomatoes and stock and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and cook for 25 minutes. Meanwhile cook the rice.
Stir in the prawns for the last 5 minutes and serve over the rice.

name: Chicken and dumplings
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a casserole dish, add the onion, carrots, celery and leek and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the plain flour, then add the stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Rub the butter into the self-raising flour with a pinch of salt, add the parsley and enough cold water to make a soft dough.
Roll into 8 balls and drop on top of the stew.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the dumplings are fluffy.

name: Slow cooker bolognese
steps: Brown the mince in a frying pan and drain off the fat.
Tip into the slow cooker with the onion, carrot, garlic, mushrooms, tomatoes, puree, wine, crumbled stock cube and oregano.
Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours.
Cook the spaghetti according to the packet instructions.
Toss with the sauce and serve.

name: Slow cooker gammon
steps: Put the gammon, onion, carrots, cloves and bay leaves in the slow cooker and pour over the apple juice.
Cook on low for 7 hours until tender.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lift out the gammon and remove the skin, leaving a layer of fat.
Score the fat, spread with the honey and mustard and roast in a tin for 15 to 20 minutes until glazed.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Slow cooker pulled beef
steps: Rub the brisket with the paprika, salt and pepper.
Put the onion and garlic in the slow cooker, sit the beef on top and add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and sugar.
Cook on low for 9 to 10 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Shred with two forks and stir in the barbecue sauce and a ladle of cooking juices.
Serve piled into the rolls.

name: Hunter's chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Season the chicken and wrap each breast in two bacon rashers.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof pan and brown the chicken on both sides.
Spoon the barbecue sauce over the chicken and roast for 20 minutes.
Top with the cheddar and return to the oven for 5 to 10 minutes until melted and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with boiled baby potatoes.

name: Chicken and bacon traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Put the potatoes and onion in a large roasting tin with the oil, garlic, thyme and seasoning.
Nestle the chicken on top, skin-side up, and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the bacon and tomatoes and roast for a further 25 minutes until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Serve straight from the tin.

name: Sausage traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes, peppers, onion and courgettes with the oil, paprika, oregano and seasoning in a large tin.
Add the sausages and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway.
Cook until the sausages are browned and the vegetables are tender and serve.

name: Chicken thigh traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the oil with the rosemary and seasoning in a large roasting tin.
Place the chicken on top, skin-side up, and tuck in the lemon wedges.
Roast for 40 to 45 minutes until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Squeeze over the roasted lemon and serve.

name: Mediterranean chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Put the vegetables, garlic and olives in a large tin with the oil, oregano and seasoning.
Nestle the chicken on top, skin-side up, and roast for 40 minutes.
Crumble over the feta and roast for 5 minutes more.
Scatter with the basil and serve.

name: Chicken and rice one-pot
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan and brown the chicken on both sides. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, paprika, turmeric and rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, return the chicken and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer on a low heat for 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve.

name: One-pot pasta
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the pasta, chopped tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, stock and oregano.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is cooked and the sauce is thick.
Stir in half the parmesan and the basil and serve with the rest of the parmesan.

name: One-pot chicken and orzo
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onion for 4 minutes, add the garlic and orzo and stir for 1 minute.
Add the stock, oregano and chicken and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the spinach, lemon zest and juice until wilted.
Finish with the parmesan and season to taste.

name: One-pot sausage pasta
steps: Squeeze the sausage meat from the skins into a large pan with the oil and fry until browned, breaking it up.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato puree, stock, herbs and pasta.
Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Scatter with cheddar and serve.

name: Chicken paprika
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a casserole dish and set aside.
Soften the onions for 8 minutes, add the garlic and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pepper, tomatoes and stock, return the chicken and simmer for 35 minutes.
Cook the noodles according to the packet.
Stir the soured cream into the sauce and serve over the noodles.

name: Sausage and lentil casserole
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil in a large pan and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrots for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and lentils.
Add the tomatoes, tomato puree, stock and thyme and bring to the boil.
Return the sausages, cover and simmer for 35 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season and serve.

name: Chorizo and potato traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes, peppers, onion and garlic with the oil and paprika in a large roasting tin.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Add the chorizo and tomatoes and roast for 20 minutes more until crisp and golden.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

name: Honey mustard chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Mix the honey, mustard and half the oil.
Toss the potatoes, carrots and onion in the remaining oil in a large tin and add the chicken.
Brush the chicken with the honey mustard mix and roast for 35 minutes.
Add the broccoli, baste the chicken and roast for 10 minutes more until cooked through.

name: Chicken and chickpea stew
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large casserole pan and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrots for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes, stock and chickpeas and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 35 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Scatter with coriander and serve with rice or bread.

name: One-pot creamy chicken pasta
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the pasta, stock and herbs and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the cream and spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Stir through the parmesan and season to serve.

name: One-pot chorizo and rice
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil in a large pan for 3 minutes until the oil runs.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and paprika.
Add the rice, tomatoes and stock and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, add the peas and cook for 5 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

name: Red beans and rice
steps: Heat the oil and fry the sausage for 3 minutes. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning, then add the beans and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Cook the rice according to the packet and serve with the beans.

name: Prawn creole
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and celery in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Add the prawns to the sauce and cook for 4 minutes until pink.
Serve over the rice with spring onions.

name: Ham hock and bean casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Soften the onion and carrots in the oil in a casserole dish for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, stock, mustard and bay leaf and lay the ham hock on top.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours 30 minutes.
Lift out the hock, shred the meat and discard the skin and bone.
Stir the meat and beans into the sauce and heat for 10 minutes.

name: Beef tacos
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the mince and brown for 6 minutes, then stir in the spices, tomato puree and 100ml water.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick, and warm the taco shells in the oven according to the packet.
Fill the shells with the beef, lettuce, tomatoes and cheddar and top with soured cream.

name: Chicken tacos
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, lime juice and salt.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave.
Fill with the chicken, avocado, red onion and coriander and top with soured cream.

name: Burritos
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the mince and brown for 6 minutes.
Stir in the spices, beans and 100ml water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and layer each with rice, the beef mixture, cheddar, salsa and soured cream.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Toast in a dry pan seam-side down for 2 minutes to seal.

name: Burrito bowls
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet and stir in the lime juice and coriander.
Toss the chicken with the cumin and paprika and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the black beans and sweetcorn in a pan.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the chicken, beans, sweetcorn, tomatoes and avocado.
Finish with a spoonful of soured cream.

name: Chicken enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Soften the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the tomatoes, puree and spices and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix the chicken with half the sauce and a third of the cheddar.
Fill the tortillas, roll up and lay seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with the rest of the cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and serve with soured cream.

name: Beef enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Soften the onion in the oil, add the mince and brown for 6 minutes.
Stir in the spices, tomatoes, puree and beans and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon the beef into the tortillas, roll up and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Top with the cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Scatter with coriander.

name: Bean enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, spices, tomatoes and puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the bean mixture and some cheddar, roll up and place in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar and bake for 20 minutes.
Scatter with coriander to serve.

name: Nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Spread the tortilla chips over a large baking tray.
Scatter over the beans, cheddar and jalapenos.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese has melted.
Top with the onion and tomatoes and serve with soured cream and salsa.

name: Loaded beef nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the mince and brown.
Stir in the spices, tomato puree and 50ml water and cook for 5 minutes.
Spread the chips over a large tray, top with the mince, cheddar and jalapenos.
Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling.
Top with the avocado, soured cream and coriander.

name: Beef fajitas
ingredients: 500g beef rump steak, sliced into strips
steps: Toss the steak with the paprika, cumin, garlic powder, lime juice and 1 tbsp oil.
Fry the peppers and onion in the remaining oil over a high heat for 5 minutes and remove.
Fry the steak for 3 to 4 minutes in the same pan, then return the vegetables.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the fajita mix, soured cream and cheddar.

name: Chilli cheese fries
steps: Bake the chips according to the packet instructions.
Fry the onion in the oil, add the mince and brown, then stir in the spices and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Tip the chips onto a baking tray, spoon over the chilli and top with the cheddar.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until melted.
Scatter with spring onions and jalapenos.

name: Taco salad
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 8 minutes, stir in the spices and 50ml water and cook for 3 minutes. Leave to cool slightly.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes, sweetcorn and avocado between bowls.
Top with the warm mince, crushed tortilla chips and cheddar.
Serve with soured cream and salsa.

name: Mexican rice
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, rice, tomato puree and spices.
Stir for 1 minute, then pour in the stock and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer on a low heat for 12 minutes, add the peas and cook for 5 minutes more.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and stir in the coriander.

name: Refried beans
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin.
Add the beans and stock and cook for 5 minutes.
Mash with a potato masher, adding a splash more stock if it gets too thick.
Stir in the lime juice and season to taste.

name: Guacamole
steps: Halve and stone the avocados and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash roughly with a fork and stir in the lime juice.
Mix in the onion, tomatoes, chilli and coriander.
Season well and serve straight away with tortilla chips.

name: Salsa
steps: Combine the tomatoes, onion, garlic and chilli in a bowl.
Stir in the lime juice, oil, sugar and coriander.
Season well and leave for 15 minutes so the flavours develop.
Serve with tortilla chips.

name: Pico de gallo
steps: Mix the tomatoes, onion and jalapenos in a bowl.
Add the coriander and lime juice and season with salt.
Leave for 10 minutes before serving with tacos, nachos or grilled meat.

name: Elote-style corn
steps: Boil the corn for 8 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Char the cobs in a hot griddle pan or under the grill for 5 minutes, turning, until blackened in places.
Mix the mayonnaise and soured cream and brush over the corn.
Sprinkle with the feta, paprika and coriander and squeeze over the lime.

name: Chimichangas
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Fry the onion in the olive oil, brown the mince, then stir in the spices, beans and salsa and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the cheddar to the filling and spoon onto each tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly, securing with a cocktail stick if needed.
Brush with the vegetable oil and bake on a tray for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
Serve with soured cream.

name: Chicken tinga
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, chipotles and spices.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth if you like.
Add the chicken and stock and cook for 10 minutes until saucy.
Serve in warm tortillas with coriander.

name: Carnitas
ingredients: 1.5kg pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub the pork with the cumin, oregano, paprika and salt.
Put in a casserole dish with the onion, garlic and the orange and lime juice and cover tightly.
Cook for 2 hours 30 minutes until very tender.
Shred the meat, spread on a tray and grill for 5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with coriander.

name: Birria-style beef
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Soak the chillies in boiling water for 15 minutes, then blend with the onion, garlic, tomatoes, vinegar and spices.
Season the beef and place in a casserole dish, pour over the sauce and stock.
Cover and cook for 3 hours until the meat shreds easily.
Shred the beef and fill tortillas with the meat and cheddar, frying them in a dry pan until crisp.
Serve with the cooking juices for dipping and lime wedges.

name: Mexican bean soup
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend roughly with a stick blender, leaving some texture.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander and serve with tortilla chips.

name: Taquitos
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Mix the chicken, cream cheese, cheddar, spices and spring onions.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds in the microwave so they roll without cracking.
Spoon the filling along each tortilla and roll up tightly.
Place seam-side down on a tray, brush with the oil and bake for 15 minutes until crisp.
Serve with salsa.

name: Huevos rancheros
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the garlic and spices and then the tomatoes and beans.
Simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set.
Warm the tortillas and serve topped with the eggs, avocado and coriander.

name: Buffalo wings
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika, garlic powder and salt and spread on a rack over a tray.
Bake for 45 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings in it.
Mix the soured cream with the blue cheese for a dip and serve with the celery.

name: BBQ wings
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the wings in the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt and spread on a lined tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once.
Mix the barbecue sauce, honey and vinegar, toss through the wings and roast for 10 minutes more until sticky.
Scatter with spring onions.

name: BBQ ribs
steps: Heat the oven to 150C. Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder, cumin and salt and rub over the ribs.
Wrap the ribs in foil and bake on a tray for 2 hours 30 minutes until tender.
Unwrap, brush generously with the barbecue sauce and grill or bake at 220C for 10 minutes until sticky and charred.
Slice between the bones to serve.

name: Sticky pork ribs
steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Mix the soy sauce, honey, ketchup, sugar, garlic, vinegar and ginger.
Coat the ribs in half the sauce, wrap in foil and bake on a tray for 2 hours.
Unwrap, brush with the rest of the sauce and roast at 200C for 20 minutes, basting once.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve.

name: Cheeseburgers
steps: Mix the mince with the salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce and shape into 4 patties.
Fry or grill for 4 to 5 minutes each side.
Lay the cheddar on top in the last minute of cooking and let it melt.
Toast the buns and fill with the lettuce, tomato, onion, patties and ketchup.

name: Smash burgers
steps: Divide the mince into 8 loose balls. Mix the mayonnaise and ketchup for the sauce.
Heat the oil in a very hot heavy frying pan and put in 2 balls at a time.
Smash flat with a spatula, season and cook for 2 minutes until deeply crisp, then flip.
Top with cheddar and the onion and cook for 1 minute. Repeat with the other balls.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with the pickles and sauce.

name: Bacon cheeseburgers
steps: Mix the mince with the Worcestershire sauce and seasoning and shape into 4 patties.
Grill the bacon for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp.
Fry or grill the burgers for 4 to 5 minutes each side, topping with cheddar for the last minute.
Toast the buns and stack with the lettuce, tomato, burgers, bacon and barbecue sauce.

name: Sloppy joes
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and mince and brown well.
Stir in the tomato puree, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, sugar and 100ml water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick and glossy.
Toast the buns and spoon in the filling.

name: Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and line a loaf tin.
Mix the mince, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, puree, herbs and seasoning with your hands.
Press into the tin. Mix the ketchup and sugar and spread over the top.
Bake for 1 hour until cooked through.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serve with mash.

name: Corn dogs
steps: Mix the flour, polenta, sugar, baking powder and a pinch of salt. Whisk in the egg and milk to a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C. Pat the frankfurters dry and push each onto a skewer.
Dip in the batter, turning to coat, then lower into the oil.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and drain on kitchen paper.
Serve with mustard.

name: Philly cheesesteak
ingredients: 450g beef rump steak, very thinly sliced
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in half the oil for 8 minutes until soft and browned. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil in a hot pan and cook the steak for 2 to 3 minutes with the Worcestershire sauce and seasoning.
Mix the vegetables back in and top with the mozzarella until melted.
Split the rolls, fill with the steak mix and serve hot.

name: Chicken and waffles
ingredients: 500g chicken thigh, skinless, cut into strips
steps: Marinate the chicken in the buttermilk and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
Mix the flour, paprika and garlic powder and coat the chicken, pressing it on well.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C and fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Toast the waffles according to the packet.
Serve the chicken on the waffles with maple syrup and hot sauce.

name: Biscuits and gravy
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the butter into the self-raising flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt and mix in the 150ml milk to a soft dough.
Pat out to 3cm thick, cut into 6 rounds and bake on a tray for 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Squeeze the sausage meat from the skins into a pan and fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the plain flour, then gradually add the 400ml milk and simmer until thick.
Season with the pepper and cayenne and spoon over the split biscuits.

name: Fried chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt for at least 1 hour or overnight.
Mix the flour with the spices and seasoning in a bowl.
Dredge each piece in the flour, dip back in the buttermilk and coat in the flour again.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170C and fry in batches for 12 to 15 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve.

name: Loaded potato skins
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes and bake for 1 hour until soft.
Halve them and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a 1cm wall. Brush the skins with oil and season.
Bake the skins cut-side up for 10 minutes until crisp.
Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Fill with the cheddar and bacon and bake for 5 minutes until melted. Top with soured cream and spring onions.

name: Cajun salmon
steps: Coat the salmon in the Cajun seasoning.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for 3 minutes.
Mix the avocado, tomatoes, lime juice and coriander for a quick salsa.
Serve the salmon with the salsa.

name: Blackened chicken
steps: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne and salt.
Coat the chicken in the spice mix and brush with oil.
Cook in a very hot cast iron pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until dark and cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lime wedges.

name: BBQ chicken drumsticks
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the drumsticks in the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt and roast on a tray for 25 minutes.
Mix the barbecue sauce, honey and Worcestershire sauce.
Brush over the drumsticks and roast for 20 minutes more, basting twice, until sticky and cooked through.

name: BBQ pork chops
steps: Rub the chops with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and seasoning.
Mix the barbecue sauce and honey.
Grill or griddle the chops for 5 minutes each side, brushing with the sauce for the last 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

name: BBQ halloumi
steps: Brush the halloumi with half the oil and sprinkle with the paprika.
Grill on a hot barbecue or griddle pan for 2 minutes each side until charred.
Whisk the remaining oil, honey and lemon juice and drizzle over.
Scatter with mint and serve in warm flatbreads.

name: Beef skewers
steps: Soak the skewers in water for 20 minutes. Marinate the beef in the oil, soy sauce, garlic and paprika for at least 20 minutes.
Thread the beef onto the skewers alternating with the peppers and onion.
Grill or barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked to your liking.
Rest for 3 minutes and serve.

name: Chicken skewers
steps: Soak the skewers in water for 20 minutes. Mix the yoghurt, oil, garlic, lemon juice and spices and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken and courgette onto the skewers.
Grill or barbecue for 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Rest for 3 minutes and serve.

name: BBQ corn
steps: Mix the butter with the paprika, garlic, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Boil the corn for 5 minutes and drain.
Grill or barbecue for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in places.
Spread with the flavoured butter and serve with lime.

name: BBQ veg skewers
steps: Soak the skewers in water for 20 minutes. Whisk the oil, garlic, vinegar, oregano and seasoning.
Thread the vegetables onto the skewers and brush with the marinade.
Grill or barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until tender and charred.

name: Lamb burgers
steps: Mix the lamb with the onion, garlic, cumin, mint, egg yolk and seasoning and shape into 4 patties.
Grill or fry for 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Mix the yoghurt and mint sauce.
Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, burgers and minted yoghurt.

name: Pork burgers
steps: Mix the pork mince with the onion, sage, paprika, egg and seasoning and shape into 4 patties.
Fry or grill for 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Toast the buns and spread with apple sauce.
Fill with rocket, apple slices and the burgers.

name: Hot dogs with onions
steps: Cook the onions slowly in the oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden, adding the sugar and a pinch of salt for the last 5 minutes.
Heat the frankfurters in simmering water for 5 minutes or grill them.
Warm the rolls and fill with the frankfurters.
Top with the onions, ketchup and mustard.

name: Chilli dogs
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the mince and brown.
Stir in the spices, tomato puree and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Heat the frankfurters in simmering water for 5 minutes.
Fill the rolls with the frankfurters, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar.

name: Bang bang chicken
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Toss the chicken in the cornflour and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the sweet chilli sauce, mayonnaise, soy sauce and peanut butter.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and scatter with spring onions. Serve with the rice.

name: Caesar wraps
steps: Season the chicken with the paprika and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Toast the bread cubes in the pan for 3 minutes for croutons.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and parmesan.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the lettuce, chicken and croutons and roll up.

name: Sticky toffee pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and grease a 20cm square tin. Soak the dates in the boiling water with the bicarbonate of soda for 10 minutes.
Cream the softened butter and the first measure of sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, vanilla and the dates with their liquid. Pour into the tin and bake for 35 minutes until risen and springy.
For the sauce, melt the remaining sugar, butter and cream in a pan and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour half the sauce over the warm sponge, grill briefly if you like, and serve with the rest of the sauce.

name: Apple crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Toss the apples with the caster sugar, cinnamon and water in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour with your fingertips until it looks like breadcrumbs, then stir in the demerara sugar.
Scatter the crumble evenly over the apples without pressing it down.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden on top and bubbling at the edges. Serve with custard.

name: Rhubarb crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Put the rhubarb in a baking dish with the caster sugar and the juice of the orange.
Rub the butter into the flour until crumbly, then stir in the demerara sugar and oats.
Spoon the crumble over the rhubarb and bake for 35 minutes until golden and the fruit is bubbling.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with custard or cream.

name: Plum crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190C. Tip the plums into a baking dish and toss with the caster sugar and cinnamon.
Rub the butter into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs, then stir in the demerara sugar and almonds.
Scatter the topping over the plums and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden.
Leave to stand for 5 minutes, then serve with custard.

name: Apple pie
steps: Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the 2 tbsp sugar. Mix in the egg yolk and enough water to make a dough. Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and cornflour.
Roll out two-thirds of the pastry and line a 23cm pie dish. Pile in the apples.
